24th Imperial Crusade.title: 24th Imperial Crusade
24th Imperial Crusade.description:
The 24th Imperial Crusade is a capsuleer auxiliary of the Amarr Navy that is dedicated to pacifying the low sec areas that are contested between the Amarr Empire and the Minmatar Republic. It was founded in YC110 following the CONCORD Emergency Militia War Powers Act.

On June 10, YC110, the Minmatar Elders and Thukker Tribe launched an invasion of the Ammatar Mandate and Amarr Empire with the intent of freeing as many slaves as possible. The Elder Fleet, as it came to be known, inflicted heavy damage on both nations, before it was halted over Mekhios by Jamyl Sarum. The remnants of the fleet retreated toward the Minmatar Republic, where it was allowed to pass freely despite a bounty offer by CONCORD.

In response to the aggression of the Minmatar, the Amarr Empire wished to declare war. CONCORD, however, ordered a cease fire and brought the full power of its rapid response capability to bear in enforcing this directive. However, with similar hostilities occurring between the Caldari State and Gallente Federation, CONCORD was pressured into allowing combat. Rather than plunge the cluster into the chaos of all-out war, the empires agreed to fight a semi-proxy war, utilizing the capsuleers as their main fighting force, with Navy ships acting in defensive positions only. The combat would additionally be limited only to border-regions between the hostile entities; in this case, within the Sasen, Tandoiras, and Vaarma constellations of the Bleak Lands, the Semou and Jayai constellations of Devoid, the Hed and Huvilma constellations of Heimatar, and the Essin, Tiat, Eugidi, Angils and Aldodan constellations of Metropolis.

AEGIS Secure Capital Construction Forges.title: AEGIS Secure Capital Construction Forges
AEGIS Secure Capital Construction Forges.description:
This article should be cleaned up or improved. The reason is: Significant amounts of critical site information missing, including NPC numbers and precise site mechanics due to lack of proportional risk/reward in running this site as of currently.

AEGIS Secure Capital Construction Forges is an expedition that can be received from successfully completing the AEGIS Secure Transfer Facility.

You land close to 0 on a large group of ~20 frigates, cruisers and battleships supported by Heavy GunStar sentries which aggress based on your EDENCOM standings. The acceleration gate requires an AEGIS Coded Security Key SCCF-FTS to use, which can presumably be obtained by hacking (one of) the containers.

Abyssal Artifact Recovery.title: Abyssal Artifact Recovery
Abyssal Artifact Recovery.description:
You are tasked with excavating Triglavian artifacts from Admixti Mutanite asteroids appearing in waves from an abyssal rift. Triglavians, Rogue Drones, and Sleepers (with Drifters) will try to stop you. You must mine quickly and survive.

After an initial setup period of 90 seconds, asteroids from beyond the rift will appear and a timer will begin. The site will progress through a total of 9 waves divided into three tiers. The enemy fleet compositions will become more difficult and the wave timers become shorter with each tier.

During each wave, a random Abyssal Weather effect will begin and 12 asteroids will spawn in fixed locations. Each asteroid contains 27 ore (Admixti Mutanite), each with a mass of 4 m3, for a total of 108 m3. The presence of these asteroids causes an anti-warp bubble until all 12 are depleted.

Advanced Drone Outgrowth Colony.description: Advanced Drone Outgrowth Colony is a harder but more rewarding version of Rogue Drone Outgrowth Colony.

Aether Drone Hive.title: Aether Drone Hive
Aether Drone Hive.description:
Aether Drone Hive is a Gallente COSMOS combat site that spawns in Parchanier system. It shows up as a warpable beacon in space.

This site is a bit special. It doesn't exist on its own but instead it will spawn every time someone starts the second mission for Drone Mind. The loot mechanics inside are also unique as the site "owner" automatically owns all the wrecks inside regardless on damage dealt. If multiple people are running the mission the system can have multiple sites.

The Aether Queen repairs its armor to the tune of about 150-200 DPS(a HM Drake was not able to destroy it alone). DPS Cruiser or Battleship recommended. It does about the same damage as a Tier 2 Abyssal Overmind.

Ambition modifier.title: Ambition modifier
Ambition modifier.description:
The Ambition modifier is a crucial component of the tug of war in the Insurgency system, ensuring protection against lopsided domination of subsequent Insurgencies by either Empire or pirate militias. Only one side at a time will have an increased Ambition.

An insurgency lasts a maximum of 7 days from its start date.

In this time, the Empire militias will strive to win the Insurgency by fully suppressing enough Insurgency systems according to their goal found in the Insurgency window. Meanwhile, the pirate militia will attempt to fully corrupt enough Insurgency systems according to their own set goal.

Anatomy of Incursions.title: Anatomy of Incursions
Anatomy of Incursions.description:
This article is not intended to be a step-by-step manual on how to lead an incursion fleet, but rather an article bringing up all the various aspects of running a site. To make sure you are aware of all the choices you'll need to be making and how they are influenced by what site you're doing, how your fleet members have fitted their ships, the skills they have and to what level of autonomy you can rely on them to perform without specific orders.

While primarily for people looking to step up and lead fleets, this article also serves as good read for players who wish to understand why things are done in a certain way, which helps them become more autonomous. Having pilots in the fleet who are able to adapt on the fly, knowing what works and what doesn't, is a tremendous asset to the fleet commander and greatly improved not only efficiency but also fleet safety. Just remember that while you're often given a certain amount of freedom, if the fleet commander gives you a specific order, follow it.

In short, this article is focused on making you aware of all the related things so that you have a proper foundation on which to improve your own performance or build your personal fleet commanding style tailored to the kind of fleets you'll run.

Ancient Ruins.title: Ancient Ruins
Ancient Ruins.description:
Ancient Ruins is a combat relic site only found in the Catch nullsec region, especially in the 9HXQ-G constellation. Up to T2 Battleships can enter this site. This site appears to probes as a combat site.The site is very rare and hard, and should only be attempted by skilled players. Sansha's Nation and Rogue Drone rats are present in this site. Omni tanks are highly preferable, especially EM and Thermal damage. Damage in the site can easily become excessive if care is not taken in managing triggers.

Angel Burrow.title: Angel Burrow
Angel Burrow.description:
The Angel Burrow is a combat anomaly found in Angel infested regions.

Single normal space pocket. Auto-aggression from each wave. The last ship killed triggers the next wave. Waves spawn at 30 to 60km from warp-in.

The loot would be in range of 10k to 20k ISK and the bounty would be 50k to 60k ISK. Warning: these information is not official, this is counted by me.

Angel Capital Staging.title: Angel Capital Staging
Angel Capital Staging.description:
Angel Capital Staging is an escalation site released on the 11th of June 2024 under the Equinox expansion and is designed to encourage the usage of capital class ships for running PVE within Nullsec. You can gain it from the combat anomalies Angel Forsaken Hub, Angel Haven, Angel Sanctum, Angel Forsaken Sanctum.

The site features three Angel Dreadnoughts as well as a large number of sub-capital ships. The site is designed to be run by a dreadnought fitted with anti-capital weapons, plus a smart bomb to kill the warp-disrupting frigates. In the Angel variant, a Phoenix, Naglfar, or Zirnitra are good because they can deal explosive damage. Rather avoid a Revelation as Angel have higher resists its lasers. Supercarriers can also run this site but you risk a far more expensive ship in this case.

Bounties of 180 mil isk for the three dreads with no faction or deadspace loot. Dread salvage can run up to 20 mil per wreck.

Angel Cartel Naval Shipyard.title: Angel Cartel Naval Shipyard
Angel Cartel Naval Shipyard.description:
The Angel Cartel Naval Shipyard is the Angel DED 10/10. It can be scanned in Nullsec where Angel are the local rats. Alternatively you can gain it as an escalation from the Angel Haven, Angel Sanctum, or Angel Forsaken Sanctum. When it's an escalation, you can skip the first room.

The boss named "The Antimatter Channeler" has a high volley that deals 37.5k damage for wrecking shots. That makes people die to it on a regular basis. In order to have enough buffer, it is recommended to use a battleship even though some cruisers can run it if fitted with extra buffer.

Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony.title: Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony
Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony.description:
The Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony is a Cosmic Signature of the DED Complex (rated 4/10) type, occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battlecruiser class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

The site is of medium difficulty, it can be done with a small fleet of Faction, T2 or T3 Cruisers or Battleships, but e.g. a single Ishtar can also do it.

Angel Hideaway.title: Angel Hideaway
Angel Hideaway.description:
Angel Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Minmatar Republic or occupied by the Angel Cartel. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Domination faction modules and ammunition.

This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Angel Repurposed Outpost complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Angel Hidden Hideaway, Angel Forsaken Hideaway and Angel Forlorn Hideaway.

Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Domination faction modules and ammunition.

Angel Shielded Starbase.title: Angel Shielded Starbase
Angel Shielded Starbase.description:
Angel Shielded Starbase is an escalation site released on the 11th of June 2024 under the Equinox expansion and is designed to encourage the usage of capital class ships for running PVE within Nullsec. You can gain it from the combat anomalies Angel Forsaken Hub, Angel Haven, Angel Sanctum, Angel Forsaken Sanctum.

You have to destroy a "Pirate Angel Tower" which is surrounded by a "Forcefield" which you have to destroy first to shoot the tower. Both are surrounded by a number of webbing, neuting, missile, and turret towers. When you shoot the forcefield, additional (subcap) angel NPCs spawn in multiple waves depending on your progress. The forcefield has 400k shield HP with no resists and has a shield recharge time of two minutes leading to a peak shield regeneration of 8333 HP/s. The pirate tower has 100k armor HP with no resits or repairs. That tower drops a "23rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects" in its wreck which you can sell for 133 million isk to NPC buy orders. MTUs don't pull the wreck in. (I haven't tried normal tractor beams.)

The site is designed to be run by a dreadnought fitted with anti-capital weapons, plus a smart bomb to kill the warp-disrupting frigates. Because of the high shield regeneration you need T2 weapons (and ammo) on normal dreadnoughts. Because there are no resists, the approach to different NPC types is very similar. Supercarriers can also run this site but you risk a far more expensive ship in this case.

Angel Vigil.title: Angel Vigil
Angel Vigil.description:
Angel Vigil is a unrated combat site that can be found via exploration by scanning down signatures with scanner probes in high-security systems. Its gate allows Battlecruisers or smaller to enter, and a (well equipped) Battlecruiser or HAC is suggested to bring into the site. (Addition: after completing in a Hurricane Dooobles notes that resists over 60% exp/kinetic, robust T2 tank with substantial buffer, exp/kinetic dmg dealing, web, and tracking gear are ESSENTIAL; the incoming damage is very high and the mobs kite.) The largest ship allowed to enter is a Command Ship (T2 Battlecruiser).

The gate in the first room can be unlocked either by using an Angel Gold Tag or by killing the Gistatis Smuggler Commander in the Gate Spawn. It is possible to trigger the Gate Spawn preemptively by shooting the smuggler gate.

Before shooting any tower, focus on lowering the number of enemies in the pocket. The incoming damage is quite substantial so something with a decent tank, or warp-outs are necessary. You will be webbed down to ~10% velocity or less (14.0 m/s in a BC), so speed tanking isn't possible. After the area is cleared of most of the enemies, shoot one of the stasis towers. This pocket can easily become tank-melting if you target the turrets before clearing the initial ships. After all the turrets are gone and everything's dead, shoot 'Pat's Shipyard' for the final spawn and kill him off. There are multiple cargo containers in the pocket (containing a small amount of ammo, one had faction ammo). A large number of Veldspar asteroids are in this pocket.

This site's acceleration gate allows all subcapitals to enter.

Arithmos Tyrannos.title: Arithmos Tyrannos
Arithmos Tyrannos.description:
Arithmos Tyrannos, also known as Drifter Response Battleship, is an optional encounter in C5 and C6 wormhole anomaly combat sites.

To have Arithmos Tyrannos spawn, a capital ship must be present in sites prior to the appearance of the Decloaked Transmission Array. The DTA spawns upon killing the DTA trigger for the site. It is recommended to take caution to not aggress the DTA itself before the rest of the site is dead. When you are ready for the drifter, aggress the DTA in any manner (guns/turrets/missiles/e-war) to spawn Arithmos Tyrannos.

The Arithmos Tyrannos will despawn if capital ships leave the site, or strays further than 100KM of a site’s warp-in point.

Bai Tarziiki.title: Bai Tarziiki
Bai Tarziiki.description:
Bai Tarziiki is a Caldari COSMOS combat site located in Otitoh. You can find it by scanning with Core Probes. Alternatively warp to the Ihakana stargate and the rats will be around 350 km off the gate.

Warping to either of the Bandit Outposts lands you in the center of the rats.

Bandit Hideout.description:
The Bandit Hideout is a small COSMOS combat site in Sakkikainen. It is marked with a warpable beacon that is visible in the overview. This site is a part of Caldari COSMOS.

Single ungated pocket. Destroying the ships will not result in a standing loss. This site is a source of Bandit, Drifter and Marauder Spurs.

Bazeri Palen.title: Bazeri Palen
Bazeri Palen.description:
Bazeri Palen is a static Minmatar COSMOS deadspace complex found in Hjoramold system. It has no beacon and needs to be scanned with probes. The site has no gates to limit ships.

If you warp to zero you will end in the middle of a pack of Maru battleships, cruisers and frigates. The frigates web and point you, so you can't get out while the larger ships will put your tank to the acid test. Better warp to a distance and kill the frigates first. Shooting one NPC aggroes all the rest, so drones don't have to fear anything. The named battleship "Bazeri Palen" has a strong shield tank, while the bounty is low for a ship of that size. Only take your time to kill it if you need the item it drops.

The two Maru Mikado battleships drop Mikado ID Slices, which are required to enter Ketta Tommin's Residence.

Besieged Covert Research Facility.description:
The Besieged Covert Research Facility is a Mordu's Legion combat anomaly. It can be found in any region of empire space, but only in Low Security systems. They are the only normal combat anomaly that can spawn in Faction warfare systems.

You should also put emphasis on primarily resisting Kinetic damage (while maintaining omni tank) since the cruiser lacks turrets and its missiles deal purely Kinetic damage, while the battleships output more DPS in Kinetic than all other damage types combined.

If you engage our forces, interfere with our task, or do anything else except leave immediately, we will have no choice but to attack you.

Bloc warfare refers to large fights in nullsec (and occasionally lowsec) where the largest alliances in EVE fight for objectives while utilizing extremely large fleets.

In bloc warfare large alliances fight each other over important objectives.

In sovereign nullsec, this mostly consists of fights over:

As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Blood Raider Temple Complex (The Inner S.description:
Blood Raider Temple Complex (The Inner Sanctum) is an Expedition that has a nearly 100% chance to escalate from Blood Raider Temple Complex.

This expedition only has one part, but it is VERY hard compared to its Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point variant. Advise bringing a friend or two in ships with a very strong tank and remote capacitor transmitters. Alternatively, bring ships that require little to no cap to operate. The first section is ungated, so capitals can be brought in. Past the acceleration gate, though, only T2 Battleships and below are allowed to enter.

Due to heavy neuting, the energy neutralizer towers should be a very high priority. They have high armor and structure hitpoints, though, so your ship should be able to deal enough DPS to break them quickly. There are a lot of elite frigates in this room which like to target drones, so watch them and recall them if necessary.

Confiscated Smuggler Hideout.title: Confiscated Smuggler Hideout
Confiscated Smuggler Hideout.description:
The Confiscated Smuggler Hideout is a Capsuleer Day XIX event site and a variant of the Smuggler Hideout. It consists of two gated pockets. You have to clear most of the NPCs in the first pocket to make the acceleration gate to the second pocket usable. In the second pocket, your goal is to destroy the Smuggler Captain which drops various loot (2 possible spawn). The number of NPC spawns and their size depends on the highest ship class used, especially T3 cruisers lead to significantly more NPCs. The number of ships entering doesn't affect the spawns though. This site do not provide bounties as you will fight SARO ships (non-pirate NPC).

NPCs do not drop any loot except the boss. Salvaging is pretty useless in this site. Each room contain 2 waves. All remaining NPCs will warp away when the boss is destroyed so go immediately for him when he appears. Interestingly, the vorton projector used by the Thunderchild can chain and damage to other NPCs.

Constellation layouts for Incursions.title: Constellation layouts for Incursions
Constellation layouts for Incursions.description:
The number of systems in the constellations will determine how many of each type of sites there will be. The split between the systems will follow certain criteria, but doesn't change from one time to another. So each constellation layout will remain the same unless CCP decides to change things again, like they did in the Rubicon 1.2 point-release back in February 18th, 2014.

For more information about the spawn mechanics etc, see number of Incursions and respawns and for a list of active incursions as well as recent data, see dotlan's incursions or Shadowlauch's EVE-Incursions page.

Before you add a constellations and its systems to this list, make sure that you've covered all the systems in the constellation. Open up the constellation information, easily accessible by the linked system name in the journal under the Incursions and Global Report tabs. Click the constellation name in question and look under Related Solar Systems to verify the systems and then visit each system in turn to check which type of system it is. That way we can make sure we don't miss a system or add one that isn't in the constellation in question, or mislabel a system of a different type of system than it is. Don't assume other sites or people have done this, double-check for yourself before adding this information.

Contested Caldari Mining Facilities.title: Contested Caldari Mining Facilities
Contested Caldari Mining Facilities.description:
Contested Caldari Mining Facilities is a static Caldari COSMOS combat site in Friggi.

The rats are separated into three groups. They can be aggressed separately; Huriki Vunau and a few frigates in one group, the Black Mask bandits in another, and Pansya's group along with a couple of frigates and cruisers. Aggressing all three groups can result in high DPS. The only exception is if you immediately aggress Huriki Vunau, which will draw aggro from the entire pocket.

Note that the rats also have very fast respawn timers (around 10 minutes). That means there is a very high chance of rats respawning while you are aggressing another group (e.g. Pansya's group respawns when you fight the Black Mask Bandits).

Contested Kazka Headquarters is a static Caldari COSMOS site in system of Sakkikainen. It shows up as a warpable beacon in space.

Contested Minmatar Legendary Stronghold is a static COSMOS deadspace complex found in Hjoramold system. It is a warpable beacon and requires no scanning. The site is limited to battlecruisers and below.

The COMPLEX has 5 pockets, 2 of them are dedicated to archaeology. You need a special item to access one of the pockets. MWDs work and the acceleration gates allow battlecruisers to enter. The opposing force is from the Angel faction mostly, so tank yourself against explosive and kinetic damage.

First pocket. You will face Angels in Destroyers, battlecruisers and battleships, including some sentry guns too. The whole pocket tends to aggro anyone shooting one of them (looks like only attacking sentries aggro all, other groups can be pulled seperately, as long as you accept all 4 sentries dpsing you), so be prepared for damage. All the Angels in this pocket have normal loot tables, so looting and salvaging may be lucrative. The pocket has two gates. The nearest at 11 km leads to the two archaeology sites, the other gate at 48 km to Hieron's Blaster base. No special NPCs or Structures in the pocket.

Corruption and Suppression.title: Corruption and Suppression
Corruption and Suppression.description:
Corruption and Suppression are related mechanics, indicating the control of solar system by pirate or empire forces.

As insurgency content is completed by either the Pirate or Empire militias, systems will increase in Corruption or Suppression. When certain thresholds of Corruption or Suppression are reached, the system will go up to the next Corruption or Suppression stage. Each stage can bring in new effects and shape the rules of the system. Currently(23 September 2026), only Pirate Insurgencies can affect Corruption or Suppression, but future game mechanics could as well.

In order to win an insurgency, pirate and empire militias must push systems to either Corruption or Suppression 5. When enough systems have been pushed to Suppression 5, the pirate Forward Operating Base (FOB) will become vulnerable and can be bashed like a structure. When the FOB is destroyed, the insurgency is won by the empires. Conversely, when enough systems have been pushed to Corruption 5, the insurgency is won by the pirates. The number of systems required for victory by one side starts at 5, and is modified by the ambition modifier.

Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point.title: Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point
Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point.description:
The Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point is an unrated cosmic signature site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Blood Raider infested regions of Null Sec space. It may also be received as an escalation from Blood Forsaken Hub and Blood Forlorn Hub anomalies. The site itself escallates twice, involving travel. If both escallations go in the same direction, you could end up in hostile space for part 3.

This can be run in a single Ishtar. The site appears to not aggro on Ishtar drones, so reset the aggro if that happens. The most critical part of running this is to deal with the neut batteries. Primary them but run away while you do because incoming damage will be heavy and you won't have cap. Fits with 100mn ABs and especially drone navigation modules, to get to the neut batteries faster may be best. Note that non-capital dark blood modules vary widely in price and so the site may not be worth running. It takes a long time. I destroyed all the batteries, but I recommend only destroying the neut batteries.

Killing the Corpus Pope will proceed the site to stage 2

Deepflow rifts.title: Deepflow rifts
Deepflow rifts.description:
Deepflow Rifts are a Cosmic Anomaly which can be scanned down, appearing initially as a Level 1 Combat Site, but in reality is a fishing mini game involving Tractor Beams and Loot Crates.

Deepflow Rifts are Level 1 Combat signatures that appear in both K- and J- space as well as Pochven. Upon warping to the signature Aura will inform you that a Deepflow Abyssal rift has been detected. Target Lock the Deepflow Rift and manually activate your tractor beams to start "fishing". Be aware you will need to have 'Rifts' displayed on your overview. Using a Mobile Tractor Unit is helpful for collecting the crates but does not work on the Rift itself.

Targeting the rift with a Tractor Beam has a chance to generate a Deepflow Cargo Container in space. These containers can have Blue Loot, Red Loot, and other rare items. While in the site, Tractor Beam auto-cycling is disabled, so they need to be manually activated each cycle. The site can generate up to 21 Canisters in High-sec, 27 in Null-sec and Wormholes, and 33 in Low-sec and Pochven, indicated by a tracker, and will expire after 18 minutes, also tracked on screen. Additionally, an indicator is present for stability, and if too many Tractor Beams are activated on the Rift in too short a period of time, a "surge" will happen and a force of roughly 10-15 Rogue Drone frigates and destroyers will appear.

Derelict Research Complex DG006.description:
This site is an escalation of data sites found in the Etherium Reach and Perrigen Falls and Insmother regions.

Escalation message "Amongst the research material you managed to retrieve, you find the coordinates to a nearby high-security research center."

The site follows many of the same mechanics as normal drone data sites, being impossible to fail hacks and spawning weak rats. This site cannot escalate further. The site has a total of 3 cans with increasing difficulty and higher chances of 'Augmented' BPC dropping.

Desolate Site.title: Desolate Site
Desolate Site.description:
Desolate Site is an Unrated Complex found in high sec and low sec via exploration.

You must be flying a T3 cruiser or smaller to enter the acceleration gate.

Initially there are only two groups on grid. Third group consisting of a frigate and a destroyer appears in few seconds. You can ignore the groups that have destroyers or drones. Destroying the group with frigates only will trigger additional waves.

Devil‘s Dig Site.title: Devil‘s Dig Site
Devil‘s Dig Site.description:
The Devil‘s Dig Site is a static site in Caldari COSMOS in Otitoh. At the warp in you find several Caldari COSMOS agents and about 90 km off an acceleration gate. T1 battleship can enter the site.

The Battered Artifact Crates and Excavation Notepads are easy difficulty (70 HP green core), and the Sealed Excavation Caches and Relic Digital Installers are medium difficulty (70 HP yellow core).

You need a relic analyzer to hack those cans. One of them drops an Ancient Ciphering Totem that is required to progress into the next room. This is a rare find, though.

Dirty Site.description:
Dirty Site is an Unrated Complex found in lowsec via exploration.

The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate.

Additional spawns are mostly (only?) triggered by killing frigates. Shoot triggers with caution; it is very easy to trigger multiple waves at once and the large amount of elite cruisers and battlecruisers can do serious damage.

Distress Beacon.title: Distress Beacon
Distress Beacon.description:
Conventional Sansha attacks upon shipping and trade vessels have been drastically reduced in effectiveness over the last decades, thanks to heightened vigilance and a general increase in fleet preparedness. These factors alone make the new Sansha attacks relatively minor in scale. Although Sansha forces are selecting targets with a newfound sense of opportunism not traditionally demonstrated, they are nonetheless much the same attack patterns experienced in previous years. Adapting to the challenges of smarter target selection and improved military technologies remains the primary concern.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0089. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Below is a list of enemies that spawn in this site. See Sansha's Manual for a full list of the incursion rats.

Domination Surveillance Squad.title: Domination Surveillance Squad
Domination Surveillance Squad.description:
Domination Surveillance Squad is an Expedition that can escalate from Provisional Angel Outpost.

The first three locations are usually in low security space and the last in null security space, but this can vary. For locations #1-3, take the Newly Constructed Acceleration Gate into the first pocket if no escalation is given from destroying the commander or if the commander ship does not spawn. Gistum Breaker/Defeater cruisers rarely web.

Kill Domination cruiser, loot wreck, possibly get escalation. Otherwise take the Newly Constructed Acceleration Gate.

Dread Assault.title: Dread Assault
Dread Assault.description:
An empire dreadnought has been dispatched to resolve the conflict in this sector. Your fleet’s mission is to ensure its success by supplying enough capacitor power for the dreadnought to activate its superweapon and obliterate the enemy structure. Hostile ships will attempt to destroy your ships, ECM jam your ships, and drain the dreadnought's capacitor.

This homefront operation takes place in a deadspace pocket with an acceleration gate that has ship restrictions.

There are regional differences in the site’s description, hostile damage types, EWAR and friendlies.

Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point.title: Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point
Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point.description:
Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null Security systems with Guristas presence. It can also be received as an escalation from a Guristas Forsaken Hub or Guristas Hidden Rally Point.

This site is fairly hard due to large number of ships and neuting towers. It can be done in a group of T2, T3 or Faction cruisers or a few battleships.

The site is considerably harder than the unrated complex due to heavy neuting and webbing, as well as high DPS. Again, a fleet of T2, T3 or Faction Cruisers or a small group of Battleships is recommended for this site.

Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point is an Expedition that almost certainly escalates from Dread Guristas Fleet Staging Point 2.

This site is the hardest of the three Fleet Staging Point parts, as heavy webbing, neuting and high incoming damage from spawns makes it fairly difficult to solo. Preferably use a well-tanked T3 Cruiser or fleet of battleships to handle the site, but it may also be blitzed with a well-fit Ishtar, killing only the frigates and the structure.

If using a T3 Cruiser, make sure to keep moving as fast as possible to try and avoid as much damage as possible.

You land on a beacon named 'Barbican'. No rats are present here, although wandering Drifters may show up. The acceleration gate to the lobby is 51 km from warpin.

Drifting Cask is a Amarr COSMOS site in system of Zimse. It needs to be scanned down and will respawn in the same system immediately.

If the site has defenders the cask will contain Amolah Kesti's Data Fragment I. The container is locked until all defenders are dead.

If the site has no defenders then the cask will contain Amolah Kesti's Data Fragment II or Amolah Kesti's Data Fragment III.

Drone Herd.title: Drone Herd
Drone Herd.description:
Drone Herd is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in low-security and null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). This combat site has a chance to spawn a Sentient commander rogue drone, which drops rogue components and may drop faction drone modules and items. There are two minor variations with slightly different wave compositions.

This variant contains a prominent Asteroid Colony object.

Drone Horde.title: Drone Horde
Drone Horde.description:
Drone Horde is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems).

This site comes in two forms: One which cointains a turret ring and a cloud gas centering a structure, and other that has 4 bunkers in the middle and many scattered in the corners of a square pattern.

This site contains four bunkers at 30km from landing and four other separated in a square pattern centering the bunker cluster. The initial wave spawns scattered at the "corners" of that square, all next waves spawn near the central bunker cluster. The site shows some major inconsistencies regarding the order and timing of wave spawning, resulting in some iterations spawning more than one wave at once, and in others skipping one entirely. Drone Patrol.title: Drone Patrol
Drone Patrol.description:

Drone Surveillance.description:
Drone Surveillance is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in low-security and null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems).

There are two variations of this combat site. The first variation takes place in the ruins of a megastructure and includes Light Missile Batteries in the initial wave. The second variation takes place inside an asteroid-filled cloud and includes Defense Vampire (nosferatu) batteries instead. Both variations have a chance to spawn a Sentient commander rogue drone, which drops drogue components and may drop faction drone modules and items. This site has a chance to escalate to Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation.

Total bounties amount to around 5,000,000 ISK.

EVE University Incursion Community Impla.page: EVE University Incursion Community Implant Guide
EVE University Incursion Community Impla.title: EVE University Incursion Community Implant Guide
EVE University Incursion Community Impla.description:
Welcome to the E-Uni Incursion Community's guide on recommended Implants for our fleet ships. This guide will cover the two types of implants that we suggest: Skill Hardwiring (slots 6-10) and Attribute Enhancing (slots 1-5). These implants are not required to fly in our community, but they do greatly improve ship performance. In order to use any of the implants listed in this guide, you will need to have the Cybernetics skill trained to at least level V. This will allow you to use 6% implants, which can be purchased with Concord Loyalty Points (LP) earned by running Incursions. These implants can be found at Concord Stations and cost 250 million ISK and 250,000 LP. We also recommend getting a full set of attribute enhancing implants as the effects stack and provide more utility than just a few. Additionally, if you fly multiple ships, such as a DPS and Logistics ship, consider getting implants that assist with both fits, such as capacitor, shield, or ship speed implants. One set of implants we highly recommend is the High-Grade Ascendancy Set. This set of implants improves your warp speed, allowing you to warp into sites faster, move between sites faster, and warp to structures faster. This can greatly increase your ISK/hr performance and help you train skills faster. We also cover specific types of implants for Hybrid and Laser ships, including suggestions for turret tracking speed, capacitor capacity, and turret rate of fire. Remember, these are suggestions and you can use other implants or a lesser % equivalent that you can afford.

You need Cybernetics skill to use any of the implants below. We suggest training Cybernetics V, this allows you to use 6% implants which can be purchased with the Concord LP are earned by running Incursions. These implants are purchased for 250m ISK and 250k LP at Concord Stations.

This set of implants is great of making you more ISK! You warp in site faster, you warp to structures faster, you warp from site to site faster, and you move foci faster. Getting these help you train skills faster as well as make ISK faster. The best investment you'll ever make.

Emergency Aid.description:
Your aim is to keep a friendly target alive for 10 minutes. You can provide either shield boosts or armor repairs as you wish. You will have several rats on grid with you. Killing those rats simply results in new replacement rats spawning.

This homefront operation takes place in a deadspace pocket with an acceleration gate that has ship restrictions.

Emerging Conduit.title: Emerging Conduit
Emerging Conduit.description:
The Emerging Conduit combat site appeared as an anomaly in all areas of high security space regardless of the presence of Triglavian Invasions between October 2019 and May 2020.

Emerging Conduits were introduced in October 2019, during Chapter 1 of the Triglavian Invasion. The site uses an identical layout to Minor Conduits, with significantly weaker waves, and no scrams. Initially on a 1 minute respawn timer, people claimed that they could earn as much as 500M ISK/hr across three characters using smartbomb Praxii. The respawn time was later nerfed to 10 minutes in January 2020, lowering its farmability.

This iteration of conduits were removed in May 2020, alongside the beginning of chapter 3 of the invasion. New versions of Emerging Conduits have replaced them, now exclusive to Invasion space.

FC VG Cribsheet.title: FC VG Cribsheet
FC VG Cribsheet.description:
This tool is intended for Fleet Commanders who are already familiar with their role. It is a memory aid and is not intended as a learning tool. If you are learning about incursions, be sure to start with Preparing for Incursions and study all of the pages in the Preparations list. If you are an aspiring FC, then study ALL of the Incursion Links pages. Doing the various incursion roles (Roles in Incursions) is a recommended learning process and provides a first hand perspective of the various tasks.

Remain calm. Stabilize the situation. Emergency Warp Out can be a hazardous event depending on site and wave. A fleet can complete a site with solo Logi supported by drones. The least hazardous choice will depend on site, wave and fleet composition. Sometimes the best choice is to simply finish the site.

Make sure EVERYONE is up to speed before destroying the final enemy. Make sure to Warp Wing or Warp Fleet- now is not the time to make the mistake of warping yourself and leaving the fleet behind. Have Wing Commander (tagger) ready to back you up if in the panic you make an error.

Faction warfare.title: Faction warfare
Faction warfare.description:
Faction warfare (FW) is a game mechanic whereby you can sign up to fight for one of the four empire factions (against its enemy faction) for control over certain areas of low-sec space. It was first introduced in the Empyrean Age expansion (2008) to offer players a stepping-stone into player-vs-player (PvP) gameplay. In 2022, the Uprising expansion made sweeping changes across many Faction Warfare mechanics, and the Havoc expansion (2023) added the ability to enlist with the Guristas and Angels pirate militias to fight against the empires and participate in Insurgencies.

Faction warfare is primarily centered around two war zones (areas of low-sec contested by two empires): the Amarr-Minmatar war zone and the Caldari-Gallente war zone, which each are located on the border of the two respective empires. In these war zones, players who participate in Factional Warfare attempt to conquer star systems for their empire, and are rewarded with loyalty points and increased faction standings for their efforts. Additionally, as players who participate in Factional Warfare are effectively at war with one of the four empire factions in the game, they can therefore attack (and be attacked by) players fighting for the enemy faction anywhere in New Eden, as well as fight the enemy NPC faction navies (who patrol the high-sec star systems belonging to their faction). In addition to fighting their rival empire militia, players who participate in Factional Warfare are also at war with one of the two pirate militias as part of the Pirate Insurgency. Members of the Amarr and Minmatar militias are at war with the Angel Cartel, while members of the Caldari and Gallente militias are fighting the Guristas Pirates. In insurgency warzones, empire militia members can capture plexes to increase Suppression, and pirate militia members can capture plexes to increase Corruption.

There are two ways to join Factional Warfare (the game calls this "enlisting"): join as a solo player, or join as part of a player corporation or alliance. You do not need to be a part of Faction warfare to fight those who are enlisted.

Faction warfare (Class).title: Faction warfare (Class)

Feel free to reach out to our Teaching Department via EVEmail or Discord. We are happy to help you get set up and provide assistance!

Faction warfare missions.title: Faction warfare missions
Faction warfare missions.description:
Pilots enlisted in Faction Warfare may run faction warfare missions offered by agents of the four Factional Warfare NPC corporations ("militias"). These missions work similarly to the encounter missions offered by agents of Empire corporations, although there are a few notable differences (detailed below). Note that these missions do not contribute to the core Factional Warfare mechanics (capturing or defending star systems in the war zones), although they take place in the same regions of space.

Factional Warfare missions are only available to pilots enlisted in the respective militia and their allied militia (i.e. the Gallente Federal Defence Union corporation will only offer missions to pilots enlisted with either the Gallente or Minmatar militias). As with regular missions, you can find nearby agents by using the in-game The Agency tool or third-party tools. Make sure to filter by the correct corporation:

Just like with agents from other corporation, Factional Warfare agents have a level, which indicates the difficulty of the missions they offer, and how much they reward pilots for completing those missions. In addition to being enlisted in the correct militia, you also need to have sufficiently high standings with the agents or their corporation to access them (this works the same way as accessing agents of other corporations):

Faction warfare standings.title: Faction warfare standings
Faction warfare standings.description:
Some pilots may be concerned that joining Factional Warfare will result in irreparable damage to some of their faction standings, either excluding them from a quarter of Empire space for the rest of their EVE career, or forcing them to grind their standings back up. This page aims to clarify how your standings are affected by participating in Factional Warfare.

Participating in Factional Warfare can impact your standings with the four NPC militia corporations (24th Imperial Crusade, State Protectorate, Federal Defense Union, and Tribal Liberation Force) as well as the four NPC empire factions (Amarr, Caldari, Gallente, and Minmatar). Your actions affect your standing with your NPC militia corporation change irrespective of whether you are a member of the NPC corporation or not (i.e. whether you enlisted in Factional Warfare as a solo player or as part of a player corporation).

Note that even though you are at war with one of the four empire factions, your standings with them don't actually drop merely by joining Factional Warfare; they only drop through actions you might perform (see table). Since all the standings-affecting mechanics are purely optional (e.g. you are not forced to capture complexes just because you have enlisted in Factional Warfare), you can control how much you want to affect your faction standings.

Faction warfare strategy and tactics.title: Faction warfare strategy and tactics
Faction warfare strategy and tactics.description:
In Factional Warfare you can fight for one of the four empires against its enemies for control over areas of low-sec. This page gives tips on how to make the most of the PvE and PvP opportunities in Factional Warfare (FW); for a more detailed look at the FW mechanics see Factional Warfare. Additionally, there are detailed pages on running missions in Factional Warfare and the impact of Factional Warfare on your standings.

Before joining Factional Warfare, you should at be able to fly a frigate with the "holy trinity" of midslot PvP modules: a microwarpdrive, a scram or warp disruptor, and a web. This will allow you to start looking for and getting into fights.

A good knowledge of the overview and some practice with the directional scanner (D-Scan) is also helpful. FW provides plenty of PvP opportunities for both solo players and fleets; if you want to try flying in fleets, then it may be worth refreshing your memory of basic fleet operations (see The Rookie's Guide to Fleet Ops or attend the class Fleets (CORE class)).

Federation Detention Facility.title: Federation Detention Facility
Federation Detention Facility.description:
Federation Detention Facility is an unrated combat site belonging to the Gallente Federation faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning signatures in high security systems in Black Rise within the Aokinen constellation. The site is level II scanning difficulty.

This site appears to be the target for the Caldari epic arc mission The Breakout, and will only spawn when the respective mission has been accepted. One site will spawn in every system in the constellation and will respawn after completion.

Noticing both the hard times the company had fallen upon, and the uniquely advantageous location of its headquarters, Federation Navy strategists began to formulate a plan reminiscent of the Serpent's Coil takeover. Elite raiding parties, spearheaded by some of the Federation's most capable Black Ops wings, moved in large amounts of personnel and supplies, quickly commandeering the area and fortifying it against attacks. This facility, and many others like it, would serve as a deep foothold within Caldari space, where they could offer logistics to friendly pilots, and project forces even deeper into the heart of the State.

The site is very rare and hard, and should only be attempted by skilled players. Rogue Drone, Serpentis, Angel Cartel and Guristas rats are present in this site. Omni tanks are highly recommended, especially against Kinetic and Thermal damage.

Compared to other combat relic sites, this is noticeably harder due to higher DPS, especially in the fourth and last pocket.

Forgotten Ruins is a very rare combat relic site found only in the Delve region, especially in the OK-FEM constellation. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site, and it often features large groups of Rogue Drone and Blood Raider rats. This combat site is harder than many lowsec and nullsec ones, and should only be attempted by skilled players.

The site is similar to the Bloated Ruins and Wispy Ruins. Try to avoid triggering two waves at once, as the site can then become very difficult.

Forward Operating Base.title: Forward Operating Base
Forward Operating Base.description:
Forward Operating Bases (FOBs) are the central component of an Insurgency.

Forward Operating Bases are similar to Upwell structures, except that the only features that FOB offers are tethering, docking, and fitting. All other structure services are disabled. Pirate FOBs are the target of the Zarzakh shipcaster, allowing members of Pirate Insurgencies to teleport directly from Zarzakh to the Insurgency systems.

Forward Operating Bases are invulnerable under normal operations. However, they can be made vulnerable when the Empire factions achieve their Ambition goals for the Insurgency cycle. Once made vulnerable, Forward Operating Bases may be attacked.

Forward Reconnaissance Outpost.title: Forward Reconnaissance Outpost
Forward Reconnaissance Outpost.description:
Sansha's Nation forces have established forward outposts for the purpose of reconnaissance and minor communication relays between fleets. Although these outposts play a relatively minor role they are nonetheless contributing to the Nation's larger influence over systems and must be considered equally troubling in this regard.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0091. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Guristas Den.title: Guristas Den
Guristas Den.description:
Guristas Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Guristas pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within high-security systems occupied by the Guristas Pirates. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to Titans in null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Dread Guristas faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Cruiser-sized enemy ships.

Note: The Missile Batteries may be left alive and do not count when spawning the next wave. Each wave is triggered on death of the last ship in that wave.

This site can escalate to Guristas Hallucinogen Supply Waypoint.

Destroying all hostile ships does not trigger an escalation. Three other variations of this combat anomaly exist: Guristas Den, Guristas Hidden Den and Guristas Forsaken Den.

3 NPC groups, with two more spawns upon attacking and killing the control tower. Without diamond tag, blitz is still possible, but not recommended, incoming damage becomes *very* high and the frigates point.

It seems you can skip the room and activate the gate with a Guristas diamond tag in your cargo. Destroying the EM forcefield will destroy your drones.

The sentry guns deal 53% kinetic, 40% thermal, 7% EM damage, high K and T resistance and the use of afterburner can lower sentry damage to the minimum.

History of Incursions.title: History of Incursions
History of Incursions.description:
The history of Incursions is long and storied. Game balance changes by CCP over the years have both indirectly and directly changed the shape of Incursions and the groups that run them.

This page serves largely as a collection of devblogs and patches documenting the history of Incursions and EVE University's Incursion Community. While it is a very social activity, given their subjective importance, non-balance change events are limited to those that had a substantive impact on E-UNI's Incursion Community or on the larger Incursion community.

Initially CCP ran Incursions as global events, until they were finalized and added as to New Eden in the point-release for Incursion on January 18th, followed by a few patches.

How to find Incursions.title: How to find Incursions
How to find Incursions.description:
Open up The Agency (shortcut is Alt + M or use the NeoCom) and click "Encounters" then click "Incursions". There you will see all current incursions that are active in EVE.

You can also find the incursions by opening up your Star Map (shortcut is F10, then click "Colour by" second icon) and find "Incursions" under the "NPC Activity" header. The incursions will then show up on the map. Staging systems will show up in yellow and other systems in orange.

As of March 12th 2014 you can also get information about incursions from Wollari's DOTLAN.

Hunting the Drudge Factory.description:
Hunting the Drudge Factory is an expedition that escalates from Chemical Yard.

ISHAEKA Tactical Response HQ.description:
ISHAEKA Tactical Response HQ is an Unrated Complex found only in the Monalaz constellation in the Genesis region. The site is ungated at warpin and is NOT deadspace in first pocket. It is very hard and should only be attempted by skilled players. CONCORD and Amarr Empire rats are present. You will likely receive hefty standing losses from them. Any further attempt to trespass in this area will be met by lethal force. This is your only warning.

Incipient Drone Swarm.title: Incipient Drone Swarm
Incipient Drone Swarm.description:
Incipient Drone Swarm is a Rogue Drone combat anomaly that spawns in Pochven. The site is the easiest of the Pochven anomalies and is generally run only for the loot and standings.

The site has three waves, each dealing around 200 DPS. The Rogue Drones (excluding Vexing and Punishing types) have a lot of EWAR, but it is very weak and can be easily ignored.

All rats, except for the occasional "Overmind" ships, are drone-sized targets. None of the ships, including battleships, warp scramble. Rats can drop Interstellar Navigation Logs which can be traded to Triglavian stations for valuable items. The salvage is the same as with Rogue Drones in K-Space.

Incursion fitting principles.title: Incursion fitting principles
Incursion fitting principles.description:
Incursion fleets rely rely on good resists, sufficient buffer, command bursts and active logistics. There are simply too many enemies to be able to fit a strong enough local tank, not to mention that by sacrificing a small portion of your fleet to bring in logistics instead of more damage dealers, the rest of the damage dealers can fit more offensive modules and your fleet will perform better.

Once you have a good enough tank, the rest of your spare slots should be used to augment your (and the fleet's) damage potential. While being undertanked is obviously dangerous, being overtanked is not only wasteful, but can present a a different kind of danger if done at the cost of offensive capability.

See Preparing for Incursions for more information about what skills we ask that members of the EVE University Incursion Community have trained. While other communities might have similar requirements, this is just what we recommend.

Incursion quick references.title: Incursion quick references
Incursion quick references.description:
Quick reference sheets for incursion runners. See the linked wiki pages for more detailed informations.

The following points should all be checked before starting running in an incursion fleet

For more detailed information see Standard tactics in incursions

Incursion sites.title: Incursion sites
Incursion sites.description:
Sites appear within the constellation as warpable beacons in space, visible to anyone (much like static complexes). With the exception of the staging sites, each beacon has an acceleration gate (or two) leading into the actual incursion site.

Unlike missions where you have loot and bounties the reward is simply tied to the completion of the site. The fleet that contributed the most to the completion of the site will receive a direct payout of ISK and an allotted amount of CONCORD Loyalty Points . So if multiple fleets are present when a site is completed only the fleet that did the most raw damage will receive the payout, everyone else gets nothing.

To read about how long an incursion stays up, see the longevity section on the Incursions page.

Incursions.title: Incursions
Incursions.description:
Incursions are automated events introduced with the Incursion expansion in which the NPC faction known as the Sansha's Nation, led by Sansha Kuvakei, invade space in an attempt to conquer it for themselves. Capsuleers must fight off Sansha's forces in order to return the contested space back into an area which can be more safely occupied.

Incursions are high-end PvE fleet content, well above the challenge of regular Level 4 missions and more like Level 5s. The introduction of incursions to the game added an incentive for high-level, coordinated fleet content in highsec space. Incursion PvE combat is also a controlled environment in which players can practice fleet tactics and key fleet roles such as "logistics" (that is, repairing other ships).

Contrary to missions, which normally require active tanks, incursion fleets rely on buffer tanks with high damage resistances and supported by logistics ships. The NPC enemies in incursions use electronic warfare and capacitor warfare. They also use high speed and low signature radii to avoid damage. This forces incursion fleets to develop more complex tactics to win.

Independence.title: Independence
Independence.description:
Independence is an Unrated Complex found in nullsec via exploration. The site can be blitzed because the gates aren't locked and in the final room, you only have to destroy 4 battleships.

The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate.

Acceleration gate is 50 km from warp-in. Gate is not locked. Burn towards the gate while destroying the scrammer frigates.

Insurgency.title: Insurgency
Insurgency.description:
Added in the Havoc expansion, Insurgencies are a core part of Faction warfare gameplay and add a third faction to both the Gallente-Caldari and Minmatar-Amarr warzones by including the Guristas Pirates and Angel Cartel as active participants.

Both the Guristas Pirates and Angel Cartel are participants in Faction Warfare alongside the 4 Empire Militia of New Eden's major Empires. Like the Empire factions, both pirate factions have an NPC Faction Warfare corporation that players can pledge themselves to. The Guristas fight under the Commando Guri and are at war with the Gallente Federation and the Caldari State. The Angel Cartel fights under the Malakim Zealots and is at war with the Minmatar Republic and the Amarr Empire. This means Guristas militia players and Angel Cartel militia players are fully legal targets in high security space without CONCORD intervention, for Gallente and Caldari militia players, and Minmatar and Amarr militia players, respectively. The pirate faction militia players will also be chased by Empire faction navy in high security space owned by Empires they are at war with.

The enlistment process for either of the pirate militias works in the same way as Empire militia enlistment. Players may pledge themselves to a pirate faction by going to any station controlled by said faction. To do so, the character will need an unmodified standing of at least 0.0 with the faction.

Integrated Terminus.title: Integrated Terminus
Integrated Terminus.description: This site can be done in a properly tanked battleship or T3 Cruiser, being the easiest of the C4 wormhole sites

Jakela Plantation.title: Jakela Plantation
Jakela Plantation.description:
Jakela Plantation is a static COSMOS deadspace complex found in Hjoramold system. This COMPLEX has no beacon and has to be scanned down with probes. To top it, you also need a Hacker ID Slice to use the first acceleration gate and an Imperial Navy General Insignia II to use the third gate.

You will face Amarr forces with laser guns. A reconfiguration of the hardeners to resists EM and thermal damage might be a good idea. The damage output is high, a Drake can get in trouble, at least in the second pocket. The NPCs in the COMPLEX tend to drop poor loot - only ammunition, drones, and booster charges. There are some exceptions, though. Many NPCs have bounties, but not all of them.

Needs a Hacker ID Slice to enter which is not consumed in the process. You will face Amarr frigates and cruisers organised in 3 packs. The side groups can be pulled alone, the middle group aggroes the whole room. Received damage is mediocre compared to the next pocket, but can be dangerous to not properly tanked ships. Kurzum Wingman frigate scram and web your ship, kill them first if possible. One named NPC drops a keycard needed for a COSMOS agent mission. The next gate 84 km from the warp-in point is locked until all NPC ships in the pocket are destroyed.

Kidnapped! is an expedition that can escalate from Guristas Vigil.

At first, the site may appear empty. Be warned, several groups warp in within a few seconds.

After playing the message again and analyzing it in depth, you can now hear that the speaker is describing an attack and that she, along with a group of people have been kidnapped by a locally known Gurista bandit. Either this happened so long ago that this pirate has relocated, or perhaps you just don't know the area well enough. In any case, you have no idea where to go to rescue these people.

Kyan Magdesh is a static Minmatar COSMOS site found by scanning in Barkrik, it is "home" to Kyan Magdesh and escorts. Alternatively you can warp to Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1 to reach the site.

It is not deadspaced so can be warped to at distance.

Kyan Magdesh and escorts are actually at Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1. This means that there is a chance that COSMOS belt rats are on grid. Kyram Magdesh and the belt rats are independent entities for aggro and can be separately handled. There is also a possibility for an NPC mining fleet or actual player miners to be at work at the site.

Labyrinth.title: Labyrinth
Labyrinth.description:
Labyrinth is an Amarr COSMOS site located in Aphi. The site needs to be scanned with core probes. The site does not move so a bookmark of it is permanent.

At the warp-in point there is one acceleration gate: "Gate to the Labyrinth". The gate requires "Key to the Labyrinth" and Archaeology I. The key is received as a reward from The Curator. The key is not consumed on use.

Visiting the Labyrinth is not required by any COSMOS agent or mission, but the center stage spawns many relic containers with loot that is required to build COSMOS storyline items. The Labyrinth is heavily farmed.

pockets.heading: Center pocket
lines: 4x Elite Frigate (Blood Raider Heretic Hunter) — Warp Disruptor; Stasis Webifier

Limited Mining Expedition.title: Limited Mining Expedition
Limited Mining Expedition.description:
In a limited mining expedition site, you need to mine 10,000 units of ore and deposit it in the friendly Orca, while under attack from enemy frigates.

Rewards are based on total time taken to complete the site.

Loose Ends.title: Loose Ends
Loose Ends.description:
Loose Ends is an expedition that can escalate from Dirty Site.

No gate. Single pocket. A sentient cruiser at close range on warpin, all auto-aggress. Killing the strain frigate spawns 3 new ones (no further spawns from these). Killing the sentient cruiser may give you the next chapter of the escalation.

Single pocket. A sentient cruiser on warpin, approx. 20k away.

Lord Manel's Mansion.title: Lord Manel's Mansion
Lord Manel's Mansion.description:
Lord Manel's Mansion is an Amarr COSMOS site (DED unrated)

The Key to Lord Manel's Mansion is a reward of Manel's Disappearance (4 of 5).

Blood Phantom frigates have pretty high velocity and are orbiting at close range. Cruiser sized guns have a difficulty hitting them, even with tracking enhancing modules. It is recommended to either use missiles, drones or guns + Stasis Webifier.

notes: Requires Key to Lord Manel's Mansion

Lyavite in Incursions.title: Lyavite in Incursions
Lyavite in Incursions.description:
All the mining missions have fake versions of regular ore, where Lyavite is the fake version of Kernite. The volume is the same for both the real and fake version, which is 1.20 m3 per unit and can only be put on the market via contracts.

Unlike the real ore, the fake ores cannot be refined into minerals and only has value for the mining missions and in the case of Lyavite, for one of the vanguard sites in incursions.

For vanguard incursions you need a stack of 255 units (306 m3) for each Nation Mining Colony site.

Maekor's Plantation.title: Maekor's Plantation
Maekor's Plantation.description:
Maekor's Plantation is a static COSMOS deadspace complex found in Barkrik system. The site needs to be scanned down with probes. Alternatively you can warp to Planet V moon 3 where the site is located.

The complex is two pockets deep and allows all ships up to battleship size to enter. However, you need to bring an Imperial Navy Captain Insignia I to use the acceleration gate to the first pocket. The insignia is consumed on entering, but they are available in the market.

You will face Imperial Navy forces in the COMPLEX and you will get a heavy -0.24 standing hit to the Amarr empire for shooting the ships, whether in first or second pocket. Beside that, it's a good place to farm Imperial Navy insignias, you also should be able to find a Captain Insignia to reenter the first gate another time.

pockets.heading: Spawn table
lines: 1x Frigate (Imperial Navy Detective/Gamma I Support Frigate)
1x Elite Frigate (Imperial Navy Gamma II Support Frigate) — Warp Disruptor; Stasis Webifier

ships.name: Imperial Navy Gamma II Support Frigate

Magye Pirates.title: Magye Pirates
Magye Pirates.description:
Magye Pirates is a static site which can be found in the Otomainen system. You can warp to Otomainen VIII - Asteroid Belt 1 without needing to scan down the site.

Note: It is possible the non-COSMOS rats were just normal belt spawns.

Major Conduit.title: Major Conduit
Major Conduit.description:
This combat anomaly is found in either Bulwark or Second Liminality systems. It is a harder and more advanced version of the Minor Conduit site.

They contain 6 waves of Triglavian NPCs containing 16-20 ships in each.

Clearing this site helps the EDENCOM forces.

Mamo's Backyard.title: Mamo's Backyard
Mamo's Backyard.description:
Mamo's Backyard is a scannable combat signature [OUI-560] in Lirsautton system. It is a static site so it will always be in the same place so a bookmark of it never expires.

The warpin of this site houses Mamo Guerre, an agent in Gallente COSMOS. The second room contains some light combat.

The rats and items in this room respawn periodically.

pockets.heading: Structures
lines: 1x (Serpentis Stash) — Container; Locked until all ships are destroyed; 1x Crash Ultra

notes: Locked until all ships are destroyed

Mare Sargassum.title: Mare Sargassum
Mare Sargassum.description:
Mare Sargassum is an expedition found by completing Desolate Site combat sites. It may contain up to four parts. The first three will be in high-sec space, while the fourth can be in low-sec or high-sec. The sites do not have gates, and can be easily completed in a cruiser.

The initial defenders consists of around 6 frigates and one sentient drone.

Reinforcement wave triggers when the elite frigates are destroyed. It is possible to have this wave included in initial defenders, possibly due to warping through the trash construct.

1x Commander Frigate (Sentient Alvi) — Escalation trigger; Drone components, can also drop Astero chip

Maru Prison Facility.title: Maru Prison Facility
Maru Prison Facility.description:
Maru Prison Facility is a static Minmatar COSMOS complex found in Hjoramold system. The site needs to be scanned down with probes and is found around Hjoramold X. Alternatively you can warp to Hjoramold X - Moon 17. It allows battleship hulls to enter, but a cruiser should be sufficient.

On warp into the acceleration gate into the actual landmark, a Maru Prison Guard is waiting. Needs to be destroyed to allow the gate to function. Using the acceleration gate leads into a pocket with a bunch of frigates and a cruiser. The Maru Hacker on the warp in point webs your ship, the rest is about 50km away organized in 3 packs. The outer packs can be aggroed individually, shooting an NPC of the middle pack aggros all.

pockets.heading: Warp-in

Medical Twilight.title: Medical Twilight
Medical Twilight.description:
Medical Twilight is an expedition that can be obtained by running Blood Watch combat sites. It will take you to several new systems, each about 4 jumps from the previous one. Only the escalation trigger ship needs to be killed to continue the escalation.

The next wave will spawn upon attacking the Ritual Center.

The final wave will spawn when the Ritual Center is at half shield.

Menacing Mechanics.title: Menacing Mechanics
Menacing Mechanics.description:
Unlike many escalations, rats from different pirate factions are present here.

Most of the serviced ships seem to have been standard drone vessels, but you can also see some entries naming ships used by humans, even though it does not say anything about who was flying them. Some of the log entries contain extra notes on these customers and among them you find something that looks like coordinates in a system not too far away.

Single pocket containing drone and Guristas ships.

Metaliminal Meteoroid.title: Metaliminal Meteoroid
Metaliminal Meteoroid.description:
The objective of Metaliminal Meteoroid sites is to mine out the large central asteroid while being attacked by hostiles. The hostiles do not need to be killed to complete the site.

The asteroid contains 5,000 units (20,000 m3) of one of five mutanite ore types. This ore can be sold to NPC buyers in the region for an additional 25 million ISK. Residue (such as on Miner IIs) will help complete the site quicker at the cost of some lost ore.

The composition of the enemy forces varies from site to site, see Hostiles below. No new enemy ships will spawn unless any are destroyed, in which case they will eventually be replaced by reinforcements.

Mindflood.title: Mindflood
Mindflood.description:
Mindflood is an expedition found by completing Serpentis Hideout signatures. It contains four parts, each of which will be 4-8 jumps from the previous system, in high sec space (though the route may include lowsec).

Sites are not gated, and can be completed in a T1 frigate at range, though larger ships will be safer. The final named frigate requires around 50 DPS. In all sections, killing the Shadow Serpentis named frigate will trigger the next phase. If using a T1 frigate, a Tristan and proper range is highly recommended.

In the second room in each phase there is usually Elgur Erinn escorted by two frigates and they will warp away immediately.

Minecore Facilities.title: Minecore Facilities
Minecore Facilities.description:
Minecore Facilities is an Angel COSMOS site, located in the K-X5AX (Feythabolis) system.

Shortly after Minecore's conception, the Angel Cartel came in force to I-3ODK to claim their share of the profit. Minecore was forced to concede a large portion of their earnings to the Cartel, and have paid tribute ever since to keep them off their backs. Today Minecore is partially controlled by the Cartel, and their outposts are guarded by Angel ships.

2x Battleship (Angel General Protector) — Renamed COSMOS Minmatar Warlord/Gist Seraphim

Minecore Harvester Depot.title: Minecore Harvester Depot
Minecore Harvester Depot.description:
Minecore Harvester Depot is a Angel COSMOS combat anomaly located in the 3L-Y9M system. It is not static and needs to be scanned down.

Of note is the rather large ore belt of high sec material (Veldspar, Scordite) in the mission area. No information is available on the content of the rocks though, so it is not certain whether this is a viable mining site or not.

Minedrill's Alpha Excavation Site.title: Minedrill's Alpha Excavation Site
Minedrill's Alpha Excavation Site.description:
Soon after another expedition was sent to the same location, by Minedrill. This time it was accompanied by an entire fleet of State ships. Today the excavation site is heavily populated and well guarded from any pirate threat.

The Alpha Excavation Sites are where the expedition have confirmed a valuable find. The Beta Excavation Sites on the other hand are promising locations in E-8CSQ where the Caldari State expedition forces hope they will find something connected with their original discovery.

DED Threat Assessment: Critical (10 of 10)

Minedrill's Beta Excavation Site.title: Minedrill's Beta Excavation Site
Minedrill's Beta Excavation Site.description:
Minedrill's Beta Excavation Site is a COSMOS site, location unknown. This site is not static and needs to be scanned down.

Note: The 3rd pocket contains Rogue Drones (Deal: EM Th Resist: Varied) instead of Caldari State.

Soon after another expedition was sent to the same location, by Minedrill. This time it was accompanied by an entire fleet of State ships. Today the dig-site is heavily populated and well guarded from any pirate threat.

lines: 1x (Acceleration Gate) — Acceleration Gate; Locked until all rats are cleared.

notes: Locked until all rats are cleared.

Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade.title: Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade
Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade.description:
Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade is a Minmatar COSMOS [Note 1] site and the location of the mission The Audesder War Effort, Striking At The Blockade (7 of 8) in the Minas Iksan mission series. Both Minmatar Republic and Gallente Federation ships will be found in this brigade.

WARNING: In order to get to the Minmatar Command Post, you need to destroy the Extremely Powerful EM Forcefield which will cause -0.24 standing hit towards Minmatar Republic.

Minmatar Brigands.title: Minmatar Brigands
Minmatar Brigands.description:
Minmatar Brigands (NLX-810) is a static [Note 1] Minmatar COSMOS site that can be found by probe scanning in Nakugard. It is co-located with Nakugard VIII - Asteroid Belt 10 so alternatively you can skip the scanning and warp to the belt.

As the site is co-located with an asteroid belt there is a very real chance of belt rats showing up. As this is a COSMOS area they will be of the special COSMOS variant with a chance of dropping Recruitment Center Data Log or Finger Bone.

pockets.heading: Spawn
lines: 7x Frigate (Minmatar Brigand) — Renamed COSMOS Minmatar Outlaw/Thug/Raider; May drop Punk ID Slice

Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm.title: Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm
Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm.description:
Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm is a DED Rated Complex. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in Minmatar high security space.

The entry to this site is limited to T2 and Faction frigates and below.

Upon activating the acceleration gate to the room.

Upon activating the acceleration gate to the room.

Upon activating the acceleration gate to the room.

Minmatar Military Training Grounds.title: Minmatar Military Training Grounds
Minmatar Military Training Grounds.description: Minmatar Military Training Grounds is a Minmatar COSMOS site.

pockets.heading: Initial defenders

notes: Example loot: Minmatar Training Certification Results x1, Uranium Charge S x100, Inferno Light Missile x100, Metal Scraps x5, Hobgoblin I x1

Minor Angel Annex.title: Minor Angel Annex
Minor Angel Annex.description:
Minor Angel Annex is an unrated Complex occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found by probing in Lowsec. Its signal strength is 10%, making it moderately easy to scan down.

The site is accessed through an acceleration gate. While a well fit battlecruiser can solo the first part, it would be difficult if not impossible to do so for the second part. This complex is unrated and is of a difficulty similar to a 5 or 6/10 DED Rated Complexes

More defenders appear as the communications officers are agressed. The militant commander appears in last wave. The destruction of militant commander unlocks the acceleration gate. The wave information here is inaccurate and should be considered as a rough view of the site.

Minor Blood Annex.title: Minor Blood Annex
Minor Blood Annex.description:
Minor Blood Annex is a low security unrated site found through exploration. Excercise extreme caution due to multiple waves potentially having been spawned before you enter.

Upon warping to the site you will arrive at an acceleration gate.

The webbing drone in each group will spawn the next group. On some occasions multiple groups will already be present when you warp in. In final wave the destruction of Corpus Militant Commander unlocks the gate. The gate can also be unlocked with a Blood Crystal Tag. The tag is consumed.

Minor Conduit.title: Minor Conduit
Minor Conduit.description:
This combat anomaly is found when a system is either leaning towards the Triglavian Collective or the EDENCOM forces. It is a harder and more advanced version of the Emerging Conduit site.

They contain 5 waves of Triglavian NPCs containing 12-15 ships in each.

Clearing this site helps the EDENCOM forces.

Minor Guristas Annex.title: Minor Guristas Annex
Minor Guristas Annex.description:
The Minor Guristas Annex is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security regions with Guristas presence.

This site is very similar to Guristas Watch. Recommended high resists for kinetic and thermal damage.

Upon warping to the signature you will land at an acceleration gate.
