Minor Perimeter Reservoir.title: Minor Perimeter Reservoir
Minor Perimeter Reservoir.description: Site text: Fullerite is the solid-state manifestation of fullerene molecules and can be found naturally occurring within interstellar gas clouds. Fullerites are coveted for the unique structural properties that make them some of the most useful materials known to humankind. Fullerene-based technology has applications in electronics, propulsion and engineering as well as the construction of ultra-hard metal alloys and heat-resistant weapons systems. Because of the near-identical processes involved in crystal formation, fullerite clouds are acquired using the same, pre-existing gas harvester technology that has supplied booster manufacturers with their own cloud materials.

The site is behind an acceleration gate. Battlecruiser hulls and below can access it. Strategic (T3) Cruisers can not enter the site.

Museum Arcana.description:
Museum Arcana is a static COSMOS site in system of Zimse. It appears as a warpable beacon in space.

Large number of relic hackable containers defended by periodically respawning rats. Competing Archaeologists have MWDs and will fly towards you at 1700m/s. The foreign collectors fly Gallente ships and deal kinetic/thermal damage. Competing Collectors fly Caldari cruisers and deal primarily kinetic/thermal damage. Some of the containers can not be looted before the defenders are dead. Most NPC ships have no bounties and drop only standard rat loot; only the Arcana Patrons have a bounty (76K).

Nation Commander Outpost.title: Nation Commander Outpost
Nation Commander Outpost.description:
Veterans of the earlier Nation resurgence, those chiefly responsible for coordinating the planetary invasions, have made this mobile fortress their base of operations. DED surveillance has reported a range of key Nation personnel moving in and out of these temporary headquarters, although it is rare for any two to be in the same place at once, suggesting Nation is spreading its expertise across multiple facilities in order to minimize risk.

Intelligence suggests the primary role of these commanders has changed from leading large-scale planetary invasions to covert raids, as well as other special operations outside of the usual assignments handled by the larger Nation force.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0073. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Nation Commander Stronghold.title: Nation Commander Stronghold
Nation Commander Stronghold.description:
Intelligence and other supporting evidence have revealed that this facility is being used as a rally point for senior capsuleer commanders within Sansha's Nation. When one of these leaders is killed in combat or their forces routed by capsuleer counterattack, this is where they are re-cloned, and where they retreat to.

In light of this functionality, the strategic value of these outposts must be considered. By directly attacking the nexus of pro-Nation leadership, capsuleers will be able to limit the level of coordination and efficiency amongst attack squads.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0079. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Nation Consolidation Network.title: Nation Consolidation Network
Nation Consolidation Network.description:
The newly-acquired ability of Nation forces to override local system control has not yet been fully understood, and as a result, Nation forces are able to drastically affect contested systems over time, reducing the capabilities of capsuleers within their domain of control. Much of the technology used to aid this cause can be found at any of their mobile "consolidation network" facilities. This and other intelligence suggests that these complexes are primarily responsible for the initial propagation of system-wide interference.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0077. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Below is a list of enemies that spawn in this site. See Sansha's Manual for a full list of the incursion rats.

Nation Industrial Proxy.title: Nation Industrial Proxy
Nation Industrial Proxy.description:
Small scale Sansha settlements have been reported with increasing frequency since the beginning of the Nation's conventional incursion into empire space and abroad. Although these minor colonies may not appear to pose a significant threat, when considered collectively, they are an undoubtedly serving as a powerful, decentralized auxiliary network of stations and industrial depots. Sansha's plan appears to rely in part on capsuleer apathy, and the presumption that minor annexations such as these will not attract military intervention.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0087. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Below is a list of enemies that spawn in this site. See Sansha's Manual for a full list of the incursion rats.

Nation Mining Colony.title: Nation Mining Colony
Nation Mining Colony.description:
Sansha's Nation has established semi-mobile mining colonies to aid in the harvesting of ore. Due to the unique nature of these operations, which incorporate new mining technologies and hundreds of willing miner slaves, the daily amount of ore extracted from these operations would be sufficient for the replacement of hundreds of battleships. DED's conclusion is that these mining operations are a primary method of supplying the new Nation fleets with replacement vessels.

Further complicating matters is the demonstrated capability of this colony to disrupt local system-wide services. The exact nature of this technology is unknown, but appears to be dependent upon first establishing a system-wide presence. If the Sansha can be removed quickly, their potential impact upon the affected systems will be limited.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0071. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Nation Rebirth Facility.title: Nation Rebirth Facility
Nation Rebirth Facility.description:
Your objective is to destroy the Sansha fleet guarding the cloning facility. You will not be able to destroy the facility itself, your only objective is to remove the defensive fleet.

Although many parts of the Nation's cloning process are still not fully documented and understood, a few central aspects of the logistics behind their battlefield applications are clearly visible. Front-line cloning is handled in complexes that self-identify as "Nation Rebirth Facilities." Since this facility enables rapid reinforcement of the Nation's squadrons, its tactical importance must not be underestimated. For its own part, the Nation understands this potential weakness, and has made sure that cloning facilities are both highly mobile and heavily defended.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0085. DED Special Operations. Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Nation on the Rise.title: Nation on the Rise
Nation on the Rise.description:
Nation on the Rise is an expedition obtained through completion of Sansha Watch combat sites. This expedition consists of 4 different open area locations (no Acceleration gate) starting in a high security system and ending in a low security system but it can suddenly end at any step in the chain. NPC ship class encountered is Frigate, Destroyer, Cruiser, Battlecruiser and Battleship hulls.

Warning: Elite NPC's do medium lite EWAR - Tracking Disruption, Web and Warp Scram.

The initial ships will not auto-aggro on warp-in. You may have to fly some distance away from them to get within warp-in range of the Sansha ships.

Nuclear Small Arms Project.title: Nuclear Small Arms Project
Nuclear Small Arms Project.description:
Nuclear Small Arms Project is an expedition with 4 stages, and the final stage is located in a low-sec system. It has a chance to drop deadspace items. It is found by completing Angel Watch anomalies.

On warp in, there will be a stasis tower, some turrets and several mixed ships (frigs-BCs). Incoming damage is quite manageable. (Apparently) after a timer, you will either get the next location or a dead end. Shooting people seems to be optional, but there is almost always a faction ship. For me the escalation for this and the other stages in the expedition, happened immediately after destroying the "Domination" ship. Again a message in local, "Attacking the missile battery triggers an alarm, more ships are incoming!" There are 4 missiles batteries and each one adds more ships to the fray. Attacking each missile battery will cause 3 cruiser, 3 destroyers to spawn.

Total: 4.6M (Bounties:2.0M, Loot: 1.0M, Salvage 1.6M)

Whenever a site is completed, a new site will spawn immediately in another part of Pochven, with a hard limit of three sites in the region at a time.

The site comes pre locked, and will always be against EDENCOM.

A small number of EDENCOM and Triglavian ships fighting each other on the acceleration gate. Sometimes, Sleepers may also be seen fighting at the warpin point.

Override Transfer Array.title: Override Transfer Array
Override Transfer Array.description:
One of the most significant evolutions in the Nation's strategy has been the move away from abducting planetary populations. Their new tactical doctrine, which relies in part upon system-wide capsule interference, is clearly focused on limiting the power and influence of the capsuleer class.

The technology underlying the system-wide capsule overrides is not dissimilar to CONCORD's own Tracking and Response System (TRS). Where it veers into new territory is in the application of new technologies designed to override local resources in ways previously thought impossible. Intelligence gathered by DED operatives strongly suggests that this facility is chiefly responsible for establishing these overrides.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0095. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Overwhelmed Civilian Facility.title: Overwhelmed Civilian Facility
Overwhelmed Civilian Facility.description:
Shortly after appearing to change their strategic focus to capsuleers, reports began amassing of Nation forces launching smaller-scale attacks on remote or poorly defended space stations. The purpose of these attacks remains unknown, but may be as simple as serving to bolster their numbers without launching a full-scale planetary invasion. The targets of these invasions are seemingly random, and no commonality between the highly disparate attacks has yet been found.

ISHAEKA-0076 has recommended the authorization of capsuleer forces in assisting with these attacks in order to provide the most rapid and effective response available.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0075. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Pend Insurance Storage Bin.description:

The storage facility in this site drops items needed in a Gallente COSMOS mission. You can keep killing the storage facility to gain more items but they are not needed for anything and are not valuable. The rats do not agress you when you arrive or when you destroy the storage. However, you will incur -0.24 standing loss from Gallente Federation upon destroying the Pend Insurance Storage Facility.

Polar Bear Nebula is one of those few gas harvesting sites which, like Icy Nebula, is a COSMOS site as well. Therefore, the site is heavily guarded by pirate NPCs, but the amount of Minable gas makes it worth running.

Propaganda Cluster.title: Propaganda Cluster
Propaganda Cluster.description:
The Nation’s influence over system-wide infrastructure is starting to be ruthlessly exploited to the maximum extent possible. Officers in some affected systems are now reporting that Sansha have blocked local news outlets and even emergency broadcast systems from transmitting vital data. Although there are a number of obvious tactical advantages to such a move, the nature and pattern of the Nation’s censorship is neither consistent nor predictable. There may be a more subtle and insidious goal behind these attacks or perhaps their jamming technology is not yet perfected. In either case, these propaganda clusters, although militarily insignificant, nonetheless pose a significant threat to the continued stability of densely populated planets and systems under attack.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0093. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

Provisional Sansha Outpost.title: Provisional Sansha Outpost
Provisional Sansha Outpost.description:
Provisional Sansha Outpost is a Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security systems with Sansha presence.

The site rats are very far from each other, make sure to bring long range weapons and an MWD.

The Sansha Bunker sometimes drop a container with insignificant prey at launch. The Sansha Minor Refinery should definitely be fired, because the destruction can possibly lead to the the escalation: Sansha Surveillance Squad (Sansha Surveillance). The first three locations are generally in high security space and last in low security space but this can vary. The first three locations can be done in a T1 frigate at range, though for the last location a high DPS destroyer or a cruiser is advised.

Radiance.title: Radiance
Radiance.description:
Radiance is an Unrated Complex found in nullsec via exploration. It can be blitzed as the gates aren't locked and you can trigger the boss without clearing a significant part of the site. The triggers consist of a mixture of proximity triggers and just normal NPC destruction.

The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the site lands you at 0 on the gate.

The acceleration gate in the first pocket is not locked, so you can fly to it and take the gate to the next room, and thereby skip this room altogether if you want. Be careful though, as proximity to the gate spawns additional reinforcement waves, so you need a strong tank if you chose to skip the room.

Raid.title: Raid
Raid.description:
The Raid site features a central structure, a friendly NPC Freighter, and a defending hostile fleet tasked with protecting the area. During the encounter, hostile haulers will periodically spawn in close proximity to the structure and immediately attempt to align and warp out to safety.

The primary objective is to tackle and destroy at least 4 of these haulers before they can escape, then recover their cargo (each with a volume of 3500 m3) and successfully deliver it to the freighter located on the field. All of this must be accomplished within the strict 20-minute time limit, adding pressure to act quickly and efficiently.

Be advised that some enemy ships (see Hostiles below) will aggressively target any launched drones.

Rakogh Administration Complex.title: Rakogh Administration Complex
Rakogh Administration Complex.description:
Rakogh Administration Complex is a static COSMOS combat site in 3GD6-8 in the region of Catch.

Currently the complex is being used as a staging point for Sansha's offensive in the constellation, aimed at uprooting all opposition to firmly claim it as a province of the Nation. From here Pashan controls hordes of minions which scour the asteroid belts and moons and other obvious areas in search of prey.

Because of its importance, Rakogh has been the target of sabotage numerous times in the past, but with its formidable defenses few have succeeded in causing any serious damage.

Ranks.title: Ranks
Ranks.description:
Ranks are honorary titles and awards that are bestowed upon enlisted Factional Warfare pilots to reward their accomplishments on the battlefield.

Ranks are directly tied into your faction militia standings – the higher your standings, the higher your rank is. To acquire ranks and standings, you must complete Factional Warfare objectives, such as capturing control points, and finishing missions on your militia’s behalf.

As your rank will rise with higher militia standings, it will also drop if it goes down for a particular reason. As such, always remain careful about your actions, as you will be demoted should you lose sufficient standings. Leaving Factional Warfare (either the faction or the militia) will make your character retire from it and as such lose his/her rank. He/she will however recover them if joining up later on, as long as his militia standings did not drop.

Religious Fury.title: Religious Fury
Religious Fury.description:

There are two possible scenarios for this second part: one which is fairly easy, and a harder one with the overseer spawn.

Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation.description:
Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation is a DED rated combat site found in high and low security space. It is often regarded as a low value site as it contains no faction drones and has a very low chance to drop a single faction module.

Interestingly, the site can have low amounts of Rogue Drone alloys in the cans in the last two pockets that can be reprocessed for minerals.

There are minable asteroids of Omber and Veldspar, but the site will despawn shortly after the drones guarding the Scratched Cask in the last room are defeated, preventing them from being mined unless someone stays in the site, although you do have enough time to go to a nearby station to drop off.

Rogue Drone Outgrowth Colony.title: Rogue Drone Outgrowth Colony
Rogue Drone Outgrowth Colony.description:
Rogue Drone Outgrowth Colony is a Researching the Rogues combat site event where you can get valuable stuff. Enemy damage is split 50%/50% between 2 damage types, with the Colony Nest Overseer being somewhat omni with an 18%x3 + 45%x1 spread randomly. The frigates and destroyers have 0% resists in all categories while the Colony Nest Overseer has an omni tank of 33% structure and 40% Armour/Shields.

The Colony Nest Overseer is very powerful and very dangerous. It will randomly warp-in when there is 1-4 enemies left (unconfirmed). It uses Web at 10km, Neut at 5km, and Disrupt at 25km. It will warp-in at 400-500km away. After that it will warp about 20km from you. There it instantly locks you, but does not instantly disrupt (2 second delay until it activates its disruptor).

It will drop 3 Overseer Effects, but Rarely drops Random Kador, Semiotique, Valimor Legacy, and Wiyrkomi SKINs, Random Dose, Drone BPC.

Spatial Rift is roughly 7-10km from warp-in. Depending on the angle that you land you may end up <5 km from the rift and immediately trigger the proximity spawn.

Frigates will be 25-30km away and will aggro very quickly. Destroyers are 50-60km away and will not aggro unless approached or attacked.

Roles in Incursions.title: Roles in Incursions
Roles in Incursions.description:
Below are the main roles for incursions, damage dealers and logistics, what their functions are and what you can do to improve them. The finer details on more specific roles are covered in the next section.

The suggested skills are listed in order of importance, from the skills having the most impact on your efficiency on top, to those that help but are less critical at the bottom. See minimum skills for more information about what skills you're expected to train.

Below are roles you should assign to different people. By delegating these roles everyone will be able to focus on their role without being distracted. These roles and definitions are based on how we run incursions within the EVE University Incursion Community and may not reflect that of public communities.

Ruins.title: Ruins
Ruins.description:
When you warp in only frigates are on site. Rest of the initial defenders spawn shortly. Only Strain Splinter/Render/Decimator/Infester Alvi frigate types will web and point.

Most of the serviced ships seem to have been standard drone vessels, but you can also see some entries naming ships used by humans, even though it does not say anything about who was flying them. Some of the log entries contain extra notes on these customers and among them you find something that looks like coordinates in a system not too far away.

Rush Town Ruins is a static Caldari COSMOS site in system of Otomainen. It shows up as a warpable beacon in space.

The warpin area houses several COSMOS agents. There is also an acceleration gate to deeper.

When you warp in Jorek Lephny will warn you that his friend Markus will turn your ass into biomass unless you get out. You of course are here to kill Jorek and Markus.

Salvage Research.title: Salvage Research
Salvage Research.description:
The pocket contains 30 wrecks that must be salvaged within 20 minutes. Mobile Tractor Units (MTU) and tractor beams do not work on the wrecks—you must approach each wreck and use high-slot salvage modules or salvage drones directly. Be aware that hostile ships can target and destroy salvage drones.

Hostile ships will spawn and engage you. These can be ignored if your tank is strong enough, speed-tanked if you’re fast, or destroyed depending on your fleet composition.

A Malfunctioning Werpost is located in the pocket. It can be activated with a Data Analyzer module; once online, it will attack enemy ships with its disintegrator weapon. For more info please read: Hacking.

Salvation Angel's Shipment.title: Salvation Angel's Shipment
Salvation Angel's Shipment.description:
Salvation Angel's Shipment is an expedition found by completing Angel Outpost combat sites. It may contain up to four parts, each of which will be about 4 jumps from the previous system. The first three will be in high-sec space, while the fourth will be in low-sec.

As soon as you warped in to the last room, your instruments registered a large group of ships escaping the fight in the last second. Further analysis of the data indicates this was a convoy of six to eight transport ships from the Salvation Angels, accompanied by an unknown number of combat ships. Your navigational systems have already come up with a likely location for you to get to, in case you feel you have any business with them.

Taking out the Domination cruiser triggers the escalation. Assuming you always get a low bounty (and therefore short range) BS in the spawn, you can minimize DPS and fit for more gank by simply moving away from the BS after warpin. Even moving slowly you'll buy yourself enough time to take out all the BCs. The drake that had to warp in and out above had no trouble here.

Sansha Hideaway.title: Sansha Hideaway

Sansha Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition.

This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Sansha's Command Relay Outpost complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Sansha Hidden Hideaway, Sansha Forsaken Hideaway and Sansha Forlorn Hideaway.

Sansha Provincial HQ is a null security Unrated Complex found by scanning in Sansha infested space.

This site is practically impossible to solo, and is often called 'the secret 10/10'. HIGHLY RECOMMEND BRINGING FRIENDS FOR THIS SITE. For running this site, bringing a friend or two is recommended to help tank the DPS in the first pocket or break the Provisional HQ in the second room. Sansha Watch.title: Sansha Watch
Sansha Watch.description:
An Unrated Complex that can be scanned down with scanner probes. It is commonly found in highsec systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction.

Sansha's Manual.title: Sansha's Manual
Sansha's Manual.description:
The saying "know your enemy" is a good one and applies to Incursions just as well as it does any other activity in EVE. In order to know what to kill and most importantly in what order, it helps to know what the various enemies do, how hard they are to kill, what engagement range they have etc. See Anatomy of Incursions for more information on how to deal with these incursion rats.

On top of basic ship statistics like damage, speed, signature and effective hit points, ships use various means of electronic warfare. These special abilities will be represented by icons mimicking the effect of their abilities. Hover over an icon if you are unsure of what it represents. You can also sort the columns in ascending or descending order by clicking the headers (reload the page to revert to the original order).

You can also find detailed information about incursion rats from third party sites such as Chruker's and EVE Ref.

Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site.title: Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site
Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site.description:
The Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site is a DED complex found in Serpentis infested regions. In addition to being found in low sec by scanning this complex may be received as an escalation from a Serpentis Den. Medium Difficulty using T3 Cruiser, Combat Battlecruiser, Battleship (MJD).

Security forces should be mindful of any Sarpati family enforcers.

The damage can be overwhelming. However, in a cruiser sized ship, with a 100mn afterburner, you should be able to avoid most damage by orbiting a stationary target at around ~25km at ~900m/sec. Just make sure you target the rats which can hit you first, there should only be about 3-5 per pocket which can. However, this method becomes a bit difficult to execute due to the webs in the last room, so be wary. The webs practically make you a stationary target for the rats to shoot.

Serpentis Den.title: Serpentis Den
Serpentis Den.description:
Serpentis Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems).

Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Cruiser-sized enemy ships, as well as some batteries. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site complex.

This site can escalate to Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site.

Serpentis Forlorn Hub.title: Serpentis Forlorn Hub
Serpentis Forlorn Hub.description:
Serpentis Forlorn Hub is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Battleship-sized enemy ships.

This site can be done in any drone boat, such as the Vexor, Vexor Navy Issue or the Gila. A quick guide: When you enter the site, turn on your modules and drop drones. Then you want to move a bit away from the warp-in, drop down your Mobile Tractor Unit, start orbiting it while you attack the rats. You want to kill frigates first, then cruisers, battlecruiser then battleships, BUT keep an eye on what rat triggers the next wave, and leave 1 of those for last.

Around 22.500.000 ISK can be collected as bounty for the pirates, with more if the Shadow Serpentis spawn.

Serpentis Hideaway.title: Serpentis Hideaway
Serpentis Hideaway.description:
Serpentis Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition.

This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Serpentis Hidden Hideaway, Serpentis Forsaken Hideaway and Serpentis Forlorn Hideaway.

Total cargo loot amount to around 20k ISK.

Serpentis Hideout is an Unrated Deadspace Complex that is found in High Security and Low Security Gallente Space, via Probe scanning. The site consists of an entrance pocket, and two main pockets, separated by acceleration gates. If running the site in a T1 frigate, or if using light drones, take care against the Elite Frigates (Coreli Guardian Agent/Defender/Guard/Protector) as they will do higher damage than the regular frigate enemies, and will target light drones.

When you warp to the site you will land on an acceleration gate. There are no enemies on it, and nothing around other than the acceleration gate that leads to the first main room of the site.

This room contains just a couple of frigates when you warp in. Destroying them will spawn additional waves of frigates.

Serpentis Logistical Outpost.title: Serpentis Logistical Outpost
Serpentis Logistical Outpost.description:
The Serpentis Logistical Outpost is combat signature that can be found in low-sec or null-sec, or as an escalation from completing the anomaly Serpentis Yard or Serpentis Rally Point. Technically the site is an unrated complex, but behaves like a DED 6/10 and thus can be considered the Serpentis DED 6/10. The site is located behind an acceleration gate that allows T2 Battleships or lower to access and consists of two parts: Part 1 is found by probe scanning or as an escalation. Completing Part 1 will always cause an escalation to Part 2 at another location.

Warning: The Serpentis Logistical Outpost and Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 are considered to be the hardest Serpentis Escalations. Use extreme caution when completing the sites due to the Scramming Frigs and T2 Neuting Towers

You land right on top of the frigates, which mean you land in web and point range. The rest of the NPCs spawn about 30km away from you.

Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses.description:
Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning signatures in high-security and low-security systems or by getting escalation from Serpentis Hideaway and Serpentis Refuge. Cruisers (Tech 2 Cruisers can enter) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Coreli A-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as a Daredevil blueprint copy.

The Serpentis Narcotic warehouse consists of total of five deadspace pockets. Due to branched nature only four of them need to be entered to get the final reward.

Serpentis Paramilitary Complex.title: Serpentis Paramilitary Complex
Serpentis Paramilitary Complex.description:
Serpentis Paramilitary Complex is a Rated DED Complex (7/10) type, occupied by the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Nullsec systems. It can also appear as an escalation from Serpentis Forlorn Den and Serpentis Forsaken Den, in which case it may appear in lowsec.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battleship class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

Serpentis Phi-Outpost is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. Battlecruisers (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Corelum C-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules.

The electronically sealed container is unlocked after certain ships have been destroyed. The acceleration gate requires the stolen passkey to get through. The key is found in the sealed container, which is located inside a Hollow Asteroid that will require a bit of manual piloting to maneuver through to reach the container.

The above statement is not expressly true. When competing for this site I have seen my competitor take the gate to the second pocket without accessing the sealed cask. Either the key is reusable or the only requirement to jump is all enemies in the pocket being destroyed.

Serpentis Refuge.title: Serpentis Refuge
Serpentis Refuge.description:
Serpentis Refuge is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can enter this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to T2 battleships for high-security systems, and titans in low-security and null-security systems).

Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of frigate- and destroyer-sized enemy ships, as well as two batteries. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses complex.

The site is an open deadspace pocket that can be warped to at any range.

Serpentis Sanctum is a combat anomaly found in Serpentis infested null security regions.

Type 1 consists of one ungated pocket. In the pocket, you will find 5 large structures called Magnetic Double-capped Bubble and the initial NPCs between them. If you have a mobil tractor unit, start orbiting it. If not, you can orbit one of the structures in the pocket. Start by killing the smallest size ships, and save the next wave trigger NPC for last.

Information on this site is not very accurate.

Serpentis Vigil.title: Serpentis Vigil
Serpentis Vigil.description:
Serpentis Vigil is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. It is presumed that Battlecruisers (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as Tech 2 implants.

This combat site consists of two deadspace complexes, the second of which hosts Tago Uriken, the site's overseer. Access to the second complex is given by destroying all remaining hostile ships at the first complex. Defeating Tago Uriken may escalate into the Booster R&D expedition.

The gate in first room can be unlocked by killing all ships. Note that even though the message after Drug Trader is killed suggests that the gate unlocks you still need to kill all remaining ships. There are three spawns that appear to be timed.

Serpentis Watch.title: Serpentis Watch
Serpentis Watch.description:
Serpentis Watch is an Unrated Complex which can be found in Hi-sec through exploration. The biggest ships in this site are two battlecruisers, one in each pocket. Serpentis rats weakest resistance is against thermal damage and they on average deal 55% thermal damage and 45% kinetic damage. If using a drone boat, set drones to passive and focus fire so they won't accidentally shoot the trigger ship and spawn the next wave, overwhelming you.

T1 Cruisers (with good skills) T1 Battlecruisers

This site is possible to complete in a T1 Cruiser, however the damage can easily become excessive if care is not taken in managing the triggers. It is recommended to bring a well-tanked T2 Heavy Assault Cruiser or Battlecruiser.

Ship progression in Incursions.title: Ship progression in Incursions
Ship progression in Incursions.description:
There are a lot of ways to spend ISK on your incursion character in order to improve your performance, be that buying a pirate faction battleship, getting faction and deadspace modules or injecting implants into your head. Some of these options are more effective than others, so before you start "throwing ISK at the problem" with wild abandon ... take a moment to consider your options.

In general we suggest making upgrades following this rough order, designed to prioritize upgrades which require less time and ISK investment and which provide the largest benefit:

Progression varies a little between the roles of logistics and damage dealers, but is somewhat straight forward with easily identified high-end ships to aim for.

Shipcaster.title: Shipcaster
Shipcaster.description:
The Interstellar Shipcaster is a stationary structure that allows for a one-way jump to move capsuleers enlisted in Faction Warfare from their faction's Headquarters star system closer to the warzone.

To use an Interstellar Shipcaster one needs to be enlisted with the corresponding faction militia. Players consolidate efforts to build Shipcaster Beacons in the warzone; there may be from 0 to 3 Beacons active simultaneously. If there are more than 1, the Shipcaster cycles every 6 minutes through different destinations.

Beacons require 300 Smartfab Units, 10 Self-Harmonizing Power Cores, 200 Photon Microprocessors and 8000 Nanotransistors to construct. A Beacon may be attacked by the opposing militia so needs to be defended.

Shipcaster Shadow War.title: Shipcaster Shadow War
Shipcaster Shadow War.description:
The Shipcaster Shadow War was a Factional Campaign for EVE factional warfare. It began on March 14, 2023 and ended around June 20, 2023. The goal of the campaign was for each faction to build an Interstellar Shipcaster.

Building and operating these Shipcasters will require mastery of two new Triglavian-derived technologies: novel Transport Relay technology discovered in Triglavian facilities on the storm planet Athounon V, and advanced Stellar Transmuter technology that was reverse-engineered from Triglavian Dazh Porevitium Transmuters and recently tested in Vard, Egmar, and Turnur, with devastating consequences in the latter case.

Each empire has requested capsuleer support to obtain the research data required to complete their understanding of both technologies and then to assemble Shipcaster structures powered by nearby Stellar Transmuters within their territory so that they can use them to provide their militas with a significant mobility advantage in factional warfare.

Sispur's Estate.title: Sispur's Estate
Sispur's Estate.description:
Sispur's Estate is a static COSMOS deadspace complex found in Hjoramold system. This complex has a beacon visible in space and requires no scanning.

You need a Sispur Estate Keycard to activate the acceleration gate into the pocket. The keycard will be consumed in the process.

You will face Minmatar forces of the Brutor tribe in here, but you receive no standing hits for attacking them. They are organised in 4 packs of frigates and cruisers and can be pulled individually. There is a deadspace structure in the middle of the pocket, attacking it aggroes all the remaining NPCs. As long as you don't do that a battlecruiser has no issues in here, if all are aggroed the damage received can be quite high. The Brutor enforcer frigates web your ship. The loot from the NPCs is poor, you only get ammunition, drones and booster charges out of the wrecks. The only reason to go in here is when you need the deadspace structure loot.

Smuggler Hideout.title: Smuggler Hideout
Smuggler Hideout.description: The Smuggler Hideout is a Capsuleer Day XIX event site. It consists of two gated pockets. You have to clear most of the NPCs in the first pocket to make the acceleration gate to the second pocket usable. In the second pocket your goal is to destroy the Smuggler Underboss which drops various loot. The number of NPC spawns and their size depends on the highest ship class used, especially T3 cruisers lead to significantly more NPCs. The number of ships entering doesn't affect the spawns though. A full clear will net you 7.5 million ISK in bounties (before tax).

SoCT Survey Expedition.title: SoCT Survey Expedition
SoCT Survey Expedition.description:
The SoCT Survey Expedition is a Capsuleer Day XX combat event site and a variant of the Guri Malakim Survey Base site. You will face 2 waves of Society of Conscious Thought, EDENCOM and CONCORD NPCs that will need to be destroyed in order to spawn the boss wave. The site will appears as a beacon in the overview when warped to. This site does not provide any bounties as you will fight non pirate NPCs. The second wave appears to be timed, so it can spawn the boss if you take too much time to clear this wave. This site features the new Soct frigate : Metamorphosis

NPCs do not drop any loot except the master. Salvaging in this site is around 500K ISK. All remaining NPCs will warp away when the master is destroyed so go immediately for him when he appears. All the NPCs orbit quite close, generally within 10km. All enemies have uniform resistance profile, so use the ammo type you prefer.

Stabilize Rift.title: Stabilize Rift
Stabilize Rift.description:
The Stabilize Rift requires your fleet to prevent the Sleepers from collapsing an active abyssal rift. The enemy has anchored five Destabilizing Arrays, which must be drained of capacitor and held below 20% simultaneously to break the destabilization cycle.

Destroyer-class vessels equipped with energy neutralizer modules and combat drones are advised. Sleeper reinforcements may attempt to neutralize your capacitor or restore power to the arrays, forcing a prolonged engagement.

This mission demands strict coordination and precise execution. Success will stabilize the rift and will allow free passage for the Triglavian caravan.

State Protectorate.title: State Protectorate
State Protectorate.description:
We are the State, and we have claimed our long-lost homeland. Now we are at war; united, whole and full of fire and purpose. The State calls you, capsuleer, for it needs your strength and your leadership to fend off the encroaching Gallente menace. The State will not fall. Join us. Fight. Conquer.

The Caldari were once part of the Gallente Federation. Soon after the technology for interstellar travel was rediscovered in the Gallente Federation, the Caldari corporations started secret colonization of their own. Once the Gallente Federation found out about these colonies, the Federation of course demanded that they be put under the authority of the Federation. The Caldari corporations declined. The relationships were tense and Caldari Prime was put under blockade. Eventually, Caldari partisans in Caldari Prime sabotaged an underwater Gallente city. The Gallente retaliated with orbital bombardment and the Gallente-Caldari War began. The war lasted for a hundred years until the newly formed CONCORD was finally able to negotiate peace between the two factions. The Caldari Prime is still under Gallente control to this day and Gallente-Caldari relations are extremely hostile.

State Research Data Node.description:

The site appears as a data site and is found in factional warfare systems controlled by the appropriate faction and also in high security space of specific constellations.

Only T1 and Navy Faction frigates can enter these sites. Asteros are unable to enter, same goes for any Covert Ops Frigate.

Suspicious Signal.title: Suspicious Signal
Suspicious Signal.description:
The objective of this site is to destroy a single tower-like structure located at the center. At the start, the structure is either invulnerable or cloaked, and it only becomes vulnerable once three hackable arrays (data cans) are successfully hacked. Each hacked array activates a 90-second timer. If all three are hacked around the same time, this creates a 90-second damage window on the tower. The tower has 350,000 HP with no resistances.

Be advised that some enemy ships (see Hostiles below) will aggressively target any launched drones.

Common group composition is 1 Logi and 4 DPS, among which 3 are Data Analyzer.

The Kundalini Manifest.title: The Kundalini Manifest
The Kundalini Manifest.description:
The construction of the first Sansha Supercarrier is believed to have begun as early as ten decades ago, during the slow but steady resurgence of Nation forces in Stain. Various blueprints, technical documents and other evidence suggested a large-scale construction project, although a starship was not the primary suspicion at the time.

The exact technical specifications of the vessel remain unknown. Limited intelligence suggests improvements made to the jump drive calibrators, allowing unprecedented jump ranges, although this is currently unconfirmed.

The crew aboard these flagship vessels is constituted of civilians abducted during the initial planetary invasions. During one engagement with the flagship, segments of crew were ejected following an explosion deep inside the hull. DNA analyses of these crew members confirmed their origins.

The Line.title: The Line
The Line.description:
The already dim sunlight barely manages to pierce the clouds as they drift effortlessly through a tangled promenade of scarred and broken rock. Every few seconds, the ship's sensors simulate the sound of another small explosion nearby; one more camera drone that couldn't spot the debris.

The site is composed of a large collection of rocks and debris. It is about 100-150 km wide and long; enemies will spawn fairly far away.

Traffic Stop.title: Traffic Stop
Traffic Stop.description:
This 3 man Homefront Operation site is found throughout high-security Empire space. The only regional difference is the types of haulers and what damage types they are weak to.

The objective of Traffic Stop is to prevent haulers carrying contraband from reaching the station. These haulers will warp onto the grid in waves, you must cargo scan the haulers and if any of them possess contraband data, you need to destroy them. Once any hauler is aggressed, it will deploy drone frigates to attack your ships and begin accelerating rapidly until it reaches the station and docks.

The shuttles can be ignored as they never carry contraband.

Triglavian Invasion combat sites.title: Triglavian Invasion combat sites
Triglavian Invasion combat sites.description:
This is an overview of the combat anomaly sites found in the various phases of the 3rd chapter of the Triglavian Invasion. These combat anomalies can be found in the probe scanner window or in the Agency window in the systems undergoing a invasion by the Triglavian Collective. As the invaded systems escalate into later phases of the invasion, harder combat anomalies open up. For an overview of the NPCs to be found in these combat anomalies, look here. For a overview of the structures special to the invasion, look here.

Although the combat sites in the 3rd chapter share many similarities to the found combat anomalies in earlier chapters of the Triglavian invasion, they aren't the same.

The Cosmic Anomalies found in the systems invaded by the Triglavian Collective comes in three tiers or classes of difficulty. At first, in the Stellar Reconnaissance phase only class 1. of the combat sites are available, but as system progresses towards either Triglavian or EDENCOM victory higher classes will show up.

Trouble in Paradise is a four part expedition that can escalate from the Hierarchy combat site. Each part has a good chance to escalate to the next but it's not guaranteed. The first three parts are quick to run and best use a ship that can travel well, like a T3C, potentially refit for the last part. The Sentient is the trigger for the escalation and contains loot. It is spawned from the beginning. This part can be blitzed by destroying the Sentient fast.

True Creations Research Center.title: True Creations Research Center
True Creations Research Center.description:
Your objectives are to re-secure the area around the True Creations Research Center and then destroy the station itself. To do this you will first need to make use of a local CONCORD MTAC factory that has been commandeered by Nation forces. Take control of the facility and transport the MTACs to the shield transfer control tower. Once inside, they can recapture the station controls and power down the shields, leaving the research center vulnerable.

True Creations is suspected to be chiefly responsible for the re-cloning and implantation of abducted planetside civilians. In addition to this role they spearhead the development and application of new technologies. DED surveillance teams have noted, on repeated occasions now, that True Creations is now deploying mobile research centers directly to the field of battle.

Normally choosing to hide these sorts of centers well from view, this move of theirs is not fully understood. Current research is investigating the potential role these supposedly "observatory" facilities are playing in the larger battle. The proximity of these research centers to the front lines is something that will take some time to fully investigate and understand.

True Power Provisional Headquarters.title: True Power Provisional Headquarters
True Power Provisional Headquarters.description:
True Power, the leading corporation within Sansha's Nation, has acquired the means to establish provisional headquarters in areas of their choosing. The exact nature of these operations or how such large complexes are established so quickly remains unknown. The use of mobile nano-factories is strongly suspected, and would help account for the rapidity of setup. It is also possible that rogue drone technology, or even worker drones themselves, are for some reason assisting in the rapid deployment of these battle stations, although this remains unconfirmed.

The strategic value of these outposts is significant. Nation can re-equip local fighting forces at a moment's notice, transmit instructions and battle reports along secure lines, and rally retreating Nation forces that have been ejected from other strongholds, which are always in close proximity to the larger headquarters for this reason.

Synopsis from ISHAEKA-0081. DED Special Operations.Authorized for Capsuleer dissemination.

True Sansha Fleet Staging Point.title: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point
True Sansha Fleet Staging Point.description:
True Sansha Fleet Staging Point is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in null security systems with Sansha presence. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site.

The site can be difficult due to energy neutralizer sentries in the second room. Advise fitting for a strong tank against EM and Thermal damage. Warping to the site lands you on an ancient acceleration gate.

Energy Meutralizer Sentries have a decent amount of armor, so it takes a while to destroy them, even with a high DPS battleship. Their range is exactly 115km. If you are in range of both Energy Neutralizer Sentries and don't have a cap booster fitted, you will run out of capacitor before you destroy even one of them. Some good approaches are either using cap boosters or a Micro Jump Drive to get out of the range of the sentries. It is not mandatory to destroy them for the site to be completed and/or to get an escalation.

The site is NOT deadspace. You can warp around the site, and any potential hunter can warp directly to you with combat probes. The site can be difficult due to the presence of Energy Neutralizer sentries.

Cruise missile batteries deal a fair amount of EM damage. Blow them up if you can't tank the incoming DPS.

True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 3.title: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 3

Uroborus.title: Uroborus
Uroborus.description:
The construction of the first Sansha Supercarrier is believed to have begun as early as ten decades ago, during the slow but steady resurgence of Nation forces in Stain. Various blueprints, technical documents and other evidence suggested a large-scale construction project, although a starship was not the primary suspicion at the time.

The exact technical specifications of the vessel remain unknown. Limited intelligence suggests improvements made to the jump drive calibrators, allowing unprecedented jump ranges, although this is currently unconfirmed.

The crew aboard these flagship vessels is constituted of civilians abducted during the initial planetary invasions. During one engagement with the flagship, segments of crew were ejected following an explosion deep inside the hull. DNA analyses of these crew members confirmed their origins.

Vigilance Point.title: Vigilance Point
Vigilance Point.description:
Vigilance Point is a combat anomaly located in the Pochven Region.

This site will spawn 10 waves every 2 minutes, increasing in spawns with each wave. The rats themselves are random, but will be a mix of frigates, destroyers, cruisers, battlecruisers, and battleships. The structure's shields must be destroyed before each wave finishes or else the site will end.

This site has extremely high DPS but typically low tracking, with no neut pressure and is usually done in self tanking AB fit kiting Eos fleets, as the site does not target drones. Due to the sites high damp pressure, signal boosters and info links are almost required.

Waylaid Couriers.title: Waylaid Couriers
Waylaid Couriers.description:
The Waylaid State Couriers is a combat site that can be found for the Shipcaster Shadow War.

The site appears as a combat site and is found in the Aokinen constellation, in the Minnen constellation, and in the factional warfare systems controlled by the Caldari.

Only T1 and Navy Faction frigates or destroyers can enter these sites.

Wightstorm Anchorage.title: Wightstorm Anchorage
Wightstorm Anchorage.description: Wightstorm Anchorage is a Winter Nexus event that appears in the 2021 year. It contains 4 Diamond (♦) Dreadnaught and some other ships.

pockets.heading: Wave 1
lines: 4x Dreadnought (Sansha's Nation Starlight/Moonwight Rakshasa) — Warp Disruptor; Stasis Webifier; Energy Neutralizer

Wightstorm Forward Base.title: Wightstorm Forward Base
Wightstorm Forward Base.description:
Wightstorm Forward Base is a highsec combat anomaly that appears inside Volatile Ice Storms during the Winter Nexus event in 2020, 2021, 2023 and 2025.

If a capsuleer is present at the Forward Base it will appear in the Overview of every capsuleer in the same System.

Enemy ships can warp to tactical bookmarks and often target drones. They deal EM & Thermal damage with lasers, and Kinetic & Explosive damage with missiles, similar to their Incursion counterparts. Frigates have a 50k ISK bounty, Cruisers 125k, Battlecruisers 250K and the Battleship 2M. Only the Battleship drops loot.

Wispy Ruins.title: Wispy Ruins
Wispy Ruins.description:
Wispy Ruins is a combat relic site involving both combat and hacking. It appears to Probes as a scannable combat site. Unlike most combat sites, it is only found in the Feythabolis nullsec region, specifically in the I-3ODK constellation. A dedicated combat ship like the Vargur is highly recommended for this site. Avoid taking frigates into the site, as the smartbombs in the third and fourth pockets can easily destroy any frigate. The smartbomb damage can even be high enough to destroy a cruiser. Pirates from the Rogue Drones and Angel Cartel are featured.

There are four rooms in this complex but only three need to be completed. The second stage(Portal) can be skipped since the central deadspace pocket can be accessed more quickly by taking the other gate in the first pocket.

3 "Pirate Grave Robber" Angel Battleships are present on warp-in. You will land at a locked acceleration gate to the Terrace.

World Ark Assault Flashpoint.title: World Ark Assault Flashpoint
World Ark Assault Flashpoint.description:
World Ark Assault Flashpoint is a Triglavian Collective combat anomaly that can be found in Pochven. It was originally created during Invasion Chapter 1, and re-implemented in Chapter 3, which is the form it remains in.

The World Ark Assault is an extremely long and difficult site, and little formal research is available on it due to its extremely limited availability during Chapter 3. Only four confirmed runs of it were completed during Chapter 3, and each run took roughly 45 minutes. As the site only exists in Pochven, fleets preparing to attempt it must account for the Dazh Liminality Locus effects (reduced target lock count but increased remote repair strength).

The site is hidden behind an Acceleration Gate. Once a ship has attempted to warp to the site, a system-wide-visible Beacon will spawn at the acceleration gate. The site consists of a large ring containing numerous Triglavian structures, centered around a single, invulnerable and untargetable, Xordazh World Ark.

World Ark Deployment Site.title: World Ark Deployment Site
World Ark Deployment Site.description:
The world ark deployment site appears during escalating liminality phases.

The site contains the world ark and some Triglavian ships.

Capsuleers on EDENCOM side can attack the site. Capsuleers on Triglavian side can mine Bezdnacine.

Wormhole sites.title: Wormhole sites
Wormhole sites.description:
This is a full list of wormhole space exploration sites.

Cosmic anomalies and ore sites are warpable (colored green) in the scanner window when you enter a wormhole system, and do not need to be scanned down. Data, relic, and gas sites, on the other hand, must be scanned down. There are no DED complexes or acceleration gated rooms in wormhole space, with the exception of the Drifter wormholes, which are very specific in many ways and not the concern of this article.

Core ore deposits may occasionally spawn in low-class wormholes, though this is fairly rare.

Yakura Harvesting Depot.title: Yakura Harvesting Depot
Yakura Harvesting Depot.description: Yakura Harvesting Depot is a static Serpentis COSMOS site in A8-XBW (-0.2).

Yamia Mida.title: Yamia Mida
Yamia Mida.description:
Yamia Mida is an Amarr COSMOS combat site found in Zimse system. The site respawns in the same system after completion so you will need to scan it down yourself.

The site consists of single ungated pocket.

Kill the defenders and grab Yamia Mida's Remains.

Yan Jung Relic Site.title: Yan Jung Relic Site
Yan Jung Relic Site.description:
Yan Jung Relic Site is a COSMOS combat site found in Deltole system. The site shows up on overview as an beacon. Entering this site requires "Passkey to Yan Jung Relic Site", which is obtained on Sebast Mathon's mission line (involving other mission lines before him). The passkey is not consumed on use.

The Gargoyle Passkey is required to progress into the final room. It is consumed on use.

This room contains the Yan Jung cans, which can be hacked using a Relic Analyzer. While the hacks can be challenging, they can be attempted unlimited amounts of times without loss of loot. The pirates respawn very regularly, and each group is on its own timer. Therefore, it should be expected that rats will always be on grid while hacking. A ship that can permanently tank the rats is adviseable. Additionally, the pirates primary drones, and the webs from the frigates can be problematic in that regard. Guns or missiles are preferable.

Yan Jung Ruins.title: Yan Jung Ruins
Yan Jung Ruins.description:
Yan Jung Ruins is a Gallente COSMOS combat site found in Deltole system. It does not show up in overview and needs to be scanned with core probes. The site is static so it is always in the same place.

This room contains six hackable containers that must be hacked with a relic analyzer to access. The pocket is defended by a never ending stream of Drug Barons.

6x (Yan Jung Pulsing/Intact Crystal) — Hackable Structure; Medium to Hard difficulty; Materials for storyline modules

Zarzakh.title: Zarzakh
Zarzakh.description:
Zarzakh (dotlan) is a system added shortly before the Havoc expansion that has 4 static gates to 4 systems on different cardinal directions, increasing connectivity of K-space. The system features several unique mechanics tied to its role in the Pirate Factional Warfare system.

The intent behind the addition of Zarzakh was to make it a sort of pirate safe haven which would be the base for the pirate-aligned players operations. Currently, there is evidence that it does not serve this purpose: empire-aligned players can easily camp the system denying safe haven for pirate-aligned players.

Passing through a gate to Zarzakh incurs a prompt listing a fee to pass through the gate and asking for confirmation. The fee seems to be based on mass and starts at 10k ISK for smaller ships and presumably goes as high as 100m ISK for capitals. The pirate-enlisted players are exempt from the fee.
